The wife, who was used to saving money and therefore somewhat stingy, was surprisingly generous when it came to this place.
Inside the private room, the mother and daughter were chatting and laughing.
The door was pushed open, and the eldest sister Nancy walked in.
The eldest sister-in-law, who was over 170 centimeters tall, was the center of attention wherever she went.
This model-level height alone made her stand out in a crowd, and what was even more stunning was that her appearance was also very beautiful.
Her features were exquisite, extremely similar to Penny Tai at the peak of her beauty.
Her figure was completely devilish in proportion, with curves in both the front and back.
She was not like ordinary slightly thin women; her breasts were at least a C cup size, standing proudly and quite impressively.
Her figure could be described as a perfect combination, captivating everywhere with no flaws to be found.
The upper body was just an ordinary short sleeve, very casual, yet she could still wear it with a myriad of charms.
The deep V neckline revealed a hint of cleavage and sexy collarbones.
Her entire body exuded the charm that a woman in the prime of her youth should have.
The lower body was paired with denim shorts that reached the top of her thighs.
Her legs were long, snowy white, and as tender as soft tofu.
For foot fetishists and leg lovers, she was absolutely queen-level.
Such beautiful legs, if paired with black stockings under formal wear, would be pure office lady temptation.
Her cold, aloof older sister charm was not inferior to any celebrity.
As soon as Nancy sat down, she said with a laugh, "Lily, why did you choose this place?"
Lily smiled and said, "Haven’t had it for a while, was craving it.
By the way, where’s brother-in-law?"
"Him?
He’ll be here in a bit.
He’s nearby looking at some PS gaming equipment or something."

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Daniel Doubts
paragraphs: Lily smiled gently at this time, stood up and poured tea for Daniel, and said softly:
"Brother, my husband has low education but that does not mean he has no ability. Besides, university graduates are everywhere in society now."

"If we really need to find this type of job, nothing else, my women’s hospital is still hiring nursing assistants and security guards. The salary also starts at 4000 dollars. There should be no need for you to specifically ask for favors to find such a job."
After saying this, Lily sat down. On the surface she smiled very calmly, but in reality she was nervous to death.
For her, her mother, father, older sister, and even later her older sister’s husband were all absolutely authoritative figures.

Gathering the courage to say these words, she was actually panicking terribly, her palms were full of cold sweat. But after sitting down, when her husband held her hand, her face was full of tenderness, and she felt everything was worth it.
The young couple’s affection was visible to the eye. Ruth felt both comforted and full of guilt, but Nancy’s expression was a bit strange.
Daniel suddenly felt his status collapse. His authority in this family was also challenged. His mother in law was one thing, but even the usually unnoticeable Lily dared to challenge him???
"Mom, where did you buy this bracelet?"
Nancy suddenly noticed the bracelet worn on Ruth’s hand.
The Summer Cicada series gold bracelet was the most popular, all the rage for a while, even spreading to campuses. As a fashion enthusiast, Nancy could not have failed to notice.

In fact, Nancy also bought one, but it was not the style costing over thousands. She originally planned to take it out later to show off, but she was surprised to find that not only her mother, but even her second sister Lily had one on her hand.
Most importantly, just by looking at the thickness, it was definitely the most expensive model. Some gossipy women had shown off in front of her before, so she had long remembered it.
"Luis bought it for me."
Ruth said with a proud smile: "Not just this one, there is another one at home but i am too lazy to wear it."
Nancy naturally would not hold back. She grabbed her sister’s hand at once to take a closer look.
Daniel, who had just been suppressed by his mother in law until he could barely breathe, immediately found a new topic. He immediately said displeasedly: "Luis, this is too much."
"Brother, how am I too much."
Knowing he was looking for an excuse to start something, Luis ate meat skewers and asked unhurriedly.
Daniel, seeing this as looking like a guilty conscience, immediately put on a stern face, adopting the air of an elder, and said:

"Luis, this is not right. I know this series is popular now. Even if you want to please your wife and please Mom happy, you should grit your teeth, borrow a credit card, take out an online loan, and buy two entry level models.
"Two top tier ones add up to over seven thousand dollars. Where did you get that kind of money."

After saying this, Daniel turned to Ruth, both to curry favor and seemingly meaningfully said: "Mom, I think you should not wear this bracelet. Wearing a fake out and getting exposed would be so embarrassing."

"What if you pass through some security equipment, and your bracelet gets stuck as soon as it goes through. That would be so humiliating. What difference is there from a gold necklace floating on water."
"By the way, Luis, where did you buy it? The workmanship looks very good. The gold plating process is indeed good."
Daniel’s face was already completely full of mocking smile. He said earnestly: "Luis, if you have no money, then live a stable life. Do not play with these flashy and insubstantial things."
"Flashy my ass!"
Ruth’s face darkened. She directly scolded: "The invoice from the mall is right there. I know more people from the specialty store than you do. Do you suspect I am wearing a fake to show off?"
Her scolding not only stunned Daniel, even Luis was a bit stunned. Seeing she was so confident, she probably even checked the authenticity of the invoice.
Luis narrowed his eyes and smiled, looking at his charming mother in law. Ruth lowered her head guiltily for the first time all night, not daring to meet Luis’s eyes.
"Then it is even more wrong!"

Daniel suddenly slammed the table, righteously said: "Luis, what is going on with you? Your job earns just that little money, and now you have spent so much. How many times have I told you to be practical. You swiped those credit cards and online loans. Have you considered how to pay them back later?"
Saying this, Daniel felt extremely comfortable. He had seen too many of this type of person, swiping credit cards and taking online loans for advance consumption.
Even he himself had those, but unlike others who ended up failing, when things blew up, someone else always cleaned up the mess for him. That was the benefit of leeching off the family.
"How much did you rack up on things like credit cards and payday loans?"
Daniel said with increasing confidence: "Mom, even if this thing is real, after spending money to buy it, how to pay it back later? The interest is sitting there. Is it something he can afford?"
"When he cannot pay it back, you receiving collection calls every day will be even worse..."
"I tell you, repaying loans with loans only leads to a dead end. When he is buried in debt, it will drag your whole family down."
The more Daniel spoke, the more excited he became, completely unaware that his wife Nancy next to him looked slightly nervous.
According to normal southern etiquette, if smoking, at least offer him one.
But Luis lit a cigarette himself and smoked it. Smiling, he asked: "Brother, if there is a problem at home, as the oldest brother, how much money would you contribute to help solve it?
Although Daniel was excited, he was not foolish and would not fall into this trap. He immediately said, "You are the one who married into the family, why should I spend this money."
Although Daniel was excited, he was not foolish and would not fall into this trap. He immediately said, "You are the one who married into the family, why should I spend this money."
Luis slowly laughed and said, "You only realized that now? So when Father In Law is not at home, I am the head of the household. Why should you be the one to criticize and comment?"
Daniel was so angry that he slammed the table and directly pointed at Luis’s nose, saying, "You’re just a live in son in law, what are you acting so arrogant for!!"
Having endured so much humiliation, now that Mother In Law was on his side, and Nancy could be forgiven because of her long beautiful legs.
The problem was Daniel, you slick and oily guy, what right do you have? Luis did not want to endure his humiliation anymore and sneered, saying:
"What’s wrong with being a live in son in law? You Daniel, are the only son in your family, but when you got married, it was quite shabby too. Was there any glory in that?"

As soon as this was said, Nancy’s expression subtly turned displeased. It was true that the Wood Family parents were sharp and harsh, but they were reasonable and not selling their daughter. Seeing that the family was well matched and not poor, they did not have many demands when marrying off their eldest daughter.

There was no bride price and no dowry. They bought Nancy a bag, and the gold accessories added up to just over 4,000 dollars. At that time, Nancy did not think much about it, but after comparing with people around her, she felt she had married too shabbily. This was a sore point for her.
"Speaking of which, after marrying my wife, I have spent much more money in the wife’s family than you, Young Master Daniel."
Luis said lightly, "My money, how I want to spend it is my business. At least I spent it on my wife and the family."
Hearing this, Ruth seemed to have her fighting spirit awakened and immediately scolded, "That’s right, Luis doesn’t hesitate at all to spend money on me and my daughter."
"He himself is reluctant to buy clothes that cost a few tens of dollars, but he didn’t even blink when buying gold bracelets for the two of us that cost over 3,000 dollars each."

"Daniel, you’re not young anymore. You’re married now but still not sensible, always spending money on things like game consoles, drinking, and singing. How can that do? People who live properly aren’t like this."
After this exchange, Daniel’s face turned green and pale.
In the past, Ruth had always been scolding Luis, but now the firepower was completely transferred. He couldn’t break decorum and argue with his Mother In Law,

In the past, Ruth had always been scolding Luis, but now the firepower was completely transferred. He couldn’t break decorum and argue with his Mother In Law, instantly experiencing the happiness Luis had in the past.
Daniel gritted his teeth and said, "Mom, don’t be deceived by him. This guy is penniless, where did he get so much money? He must have used credit cards and online loans to get that much money."

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Showing Proof
paragraphs: "He doesn’t even have a job now, how is he going to pay it back? Not to mention, with just that little salary of his, it probably isn’t even enough to cover the interest."

This time, Nancy did not sit on the sidelines. Although it was said that the couple did not get along well after marriage, arguing every three to five days, ultimately, she could not just watch her husband be ganged up on.
Among the three sisters, the second was honest and dull, the third was quiet and introverted.
The eldest sister was like a mother and had inherited Mother In Law’s fierceness. Nancy’s mouth was not to be trifled with either.
She felt her husband’s judgment was reasonable. This live in son in law brother in law was penniless. Even though their second sister was a bit mediocre, the Wood Family was not a poor family.

Lily had only rebelled and been brave once in her life, crying, making a scene, and threatening suicide, insisting on marrying only Luis. Ruth loved this most obedient daughter dearly, which was why she allowed Luis into the family.
So Nancy also looked down on this brother in law. No matter how idle Daniel was, he had good parents and could mooch off them together with his wife. What qualification did Luis have?
Nancy also looked worriedly, holding her sister’s hand, and said, "Lily, what your brother in law said is right. You know what your own husband is like. Where did he suddenly get so much money?"
"If he said he won the lottery, I might believe it, but if he said he earned it himself, that’s impossible."
Nancy’s tone was earnest and gentle, but it was insinuating, almost directly saying that this waste didn’t have that capability.
The usually soft Lily looked at her and said, "Eldest Sister, how is it impossible? You don’t understand him."
This soft retort annoyed Nancy a bit. She was more restrained facing her mother, but facing her sister, she was a complete tigress.
"Lily, don’t be ungrateful. If he really owes a pile of debt, you won’t be able to escape it either. I’m telling you, don’t drag the family down."
Daniel also said, "That’s right, whether it’s a loan or not, just check the messages and apps and you’ll know."
"Mom, don’t be in a hurry to speak. I’m doing this for your own good. When he can’t pay back the money, it will be embarrassing when people come to splash paint on the door."
The couple, for once, were in rare agreement, speaking in tandem, already convinced that this penniless guy must have borrowed from online loans and used credit cards to please his Mother In Law.
Looking at Nancy’s contemptuous gaze, Luis sneered and directly placed his phone in front of Ruth: "Mom, look as much as you want. Let Eldest Sister feel reassured."
Ruth opened the messages on the phone. The messages showed a 50,000 dollar withdrawal income, also after stock market taxes were deducted.
She was first stunned and asked, "Son in law, you withdrew so much money again? Is there some situation?"
"Just normal operations!"
Looking at the light in Mother In Law’s eyes, Luis said lightly, "Some stocks are about to start falling, so I need to cash out in time."
Lily said with a playful laugh, "Eldest Sister, you can rest assured about this much.
"Impossible, you must have forged the messages to deceive people."
Daniel was the first to not believe it.
Luis directly handed the phone to Nancy and said with a laugh, "If Eldest Sister doesn’t believe it, you can check. See if there is any record of borrowing even one cent."
"As for credit cards, you can also check if there are any related messages. I have never applied for a credit card."
Daniel and Nancy leaned their heads together and sneered, saying, "Keep being stubborn. Let’s see how you explain later."

Then, the couple started going through Luis’s phone. Luis didn’t care; any messages that needed to be deleted were already deleted. Switching between two different Whatsapp accounts, they wouldn’t find any trace.
After looking for a while, Nancy and Daniel looked at each other, full of unwillingness.

In the massive amount of messages, no matter how they searched, they couldn’t find any trace related to credit cards. The mobile banking app showed that under his name, there were only debit cards, no credit cards.

As for those common online loan function apps, when they opened them, they were even more despairing. Not only were there no loan records, many hadn’t even been applied for or activated. No matter how much they searched, there wasn’t even a single record of an online loan.
"Impossible, you’re a poor guy who didn’t even graduate from high school. What the hell do you know about stocks?"
"Mom, he must be deceiving you."

"That text message must be forged. Everyone else loses money playing the stock market, but he can actually make a profit. Does he really think he’s some gambling god? He has no education at all. Could he even understand those financial reports?"
Daniel was practically spitting with rage, his face twisting as he spoke.
He immediately opened the stock trading app, navigated with practiced ease to the personal account section, and then froze completely upon seeing what was displayed.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Nancy Changing Sides
paragraphs: "You don’t even have a car for getting around. Second Sister rides that broken down electric bike to work every day. She must suffer terribly when it’s windy or rainy." Daniel had found a new angle from which to criticize, feeling he could turn this situation around and reclaim the moral high ground.
"Brother, I haven’t even gotten my driver’s license yet. Even if I had a car, I wouldn’t dare drive it."
"Daniel, Mom actually does have a license, but she’s forgotten how to drive."

"And besides, Mom doesn’t travel far. She can just walk to the teahouse. It’s Lily who really needs to hurry up and get her license." The mother and daughter spoke up, completely unaffected by his attempts to stir the pot. No matter how he tried to fan the flames or make snide remarks, it all fell flat.

What disgusted Daniel the most was that Nancy, who had always echoed his sentiments and matched her mother’s strong personality, actually seemed to ponder for a moment before asking in an uncharacteristically gentle tone.
"It’s true, buying a car probably isn’t necessary right now."

Then, shifting her focus, Nancy looked at Luis and said, "But Brother in law, you’d rather squeeze onto the bus for your commute to work, yet you spend money on jewelry for Lily and Mom. I actually think you should buy yourself a car instead."

This statement almost made Daniel vomit blood. On the surface, it seemed his wife was agreeing with his point and supporting him, but no matter how he heard it, it sounded like she was praising this brother in law for being exceptionally considerate and selfless.
He’d rather endure hardship himself than be good to his wife and mother in law. What the hell...
Sure enough, Daniel saw Mother In Law Ruth’s smile become even more benevolent, and Lily’s eyes fill with even more tender, loving affection.
"He’s fine, but Brother-in-law is right."
Luis was now a scheming bastard. His ability to carefully observe everyone’s expressions, analyze and gauge their psychology, and cater to their preferences had reached its peak.
Seeing his sister-in-law Nancy’s change in attitude, Luis immediately took his wife’s hand and smiled, "We should buy a car, but one probably won’t be enough."
"Let’s buy a cheaper one first, for Mom and Lily to practice with."
"If a cheaper one gets scratched or bumped, it won’t be heartbreaking. After they get used to it, we can buy two better ones."
Nancy asked curiously, "Why buy two? If you go to work, you can go out with Lily together. You’re on the way."
Ruth also said, "Exactly. Cars are easy to buy but hard to maintain. They cost a lot of money every year."
Luis looked deeply at Ruth. Just one glance made the guilty beautiful Mother-in-Law blush and turn her head away in embarrassment.

Lily immediately said, "It doesn’t matter if I drive or not. The electric scooter is more convenient and doesn’t get stuck in traffic. Mainly, if husband has something to do, he’ll need to drive too, right?"
Luis said, "One for Lily to commute to work, one for Mom to use. When Mom doesn’t need it, I can occasionally borrow it."
Daniel, who had already lifted a rock and dropped it on his own foot, immediately chimed in again, "Just say you’re buying it for yourself. What ’sharing with Mom’ is just an excuse.
"If you’re reluctant to spend money, just say it. Why make it sound so nice to trick Mom? People who don’t know would think you’re really buying her a car."
This time, he hit the key point, and it was somewhat reasonable. Daniel sneered, wanting to see how Luis would answer.

Nancy thought about it and seemed to agree, because their mother only went out to play cards every day, or at most bought groceries nearby. If they bought a car, the utilization rate would definitely be low, and Luis would definitely be the one driving it.
Daniel crossed his arms, looking like he was waiting to see how Luis would quibble. In his impression, Luis was honest and clumsy with words, just like his wife, a closed-off person.
Now that he had been poked in a sore spot, there was no way he could explain it properly.
Luis burst out laughing. "Brother-in-law, after all, you don’t live with us. You haven’t seen what those card partners of Mom’s are like, what those so-called friends are like, or those neighbors."
"Okay, tell me, what are they like?"
Daniel looked confident.
But Nancy was stunned and thought about it. After all, she grew up in this family and had already vaguely guessed what was going on.
Luis looked deeply at his Mother-in-Law again and said, "Those bitches know our family doesn’t have a car. Like Brother-in-law, they think I’m useless, so sometimes they speak with sarcasm."

"On weekends, they go to rural homestays in the suburbs together, saying things like ’there’s room in my car’... Or those card partners say things like going out to eat together, they can take their car and go together."
This brought back bad memories for Ruth, who slapped the table angrily.
"That’s right, those bitches are doing it on purpose. They even say things like going on self-drive tours together..."
"What the hell are they showing off for? It’s just a car worth a little over a ten thousand, some are only worth thousands for commuting. It pisses me off."
This brought up shared memories for the sisters. In this kind of native community, neighborly harmony is just talk.

It’s like how many people misunderstand the countryside as having simple folk customs. In fact, it’s even more vicious and spiteful, laughing at those who have nothing, jealous of those who have something, with green-eyed monsters everywhere, seizing every opportunity to make sarcastic remarks.

Nancy immediately shared the same enemy. "That’s right, I remember Aunt keel the most. I was waiting for the bus, and she had to stop her car and say things like ’your family has so many people, squeezing into the bus is so impractical’."
"Exactly, those disgusting people."
Lily was good-tempered, but she couldn’t control sharing the same enemy.
The mother and daughters immediately shared the same enemy, recounting those sarcastic bitches.
Suddenly, they united. Daniel was a bit annoyed, and what was most disgusting was that his wife seemed to have defected too.
Lily said indignantly, "Husband, I want a cheaper, smaller one that’s easier to park. It can be a practice car. Buy a better one for Mom, so Mom can properly vent her anger."
As soon as she said this, Ruth was full of relief, and the more she looked at her well-behaved and sensible second daughter, the more she liked her.

Nancy was also very sensible and took her mother’s hand, saying seriously, "Mom, before Luis buys the car, if anyone invites you to rural homestays or self-drive tours, tell me. I’ll immediately drive over to pick you up."

When they got married, Daniel drove a Nissan worth a little over a ten thousand. Both husband and wife were vain, so they sold this car, and then the in-laws added some money to buy a second-hand BMW worth over thirty thousand.
No matter what, a BMW has prestige. Besides, how many women understand what series it is? As long as the interior is luxurious enough.
Yo yo... Even Nancy became sensible. Ruth could be said to be flattered.
Among the three daughters, the one who argued with her the most was Nancy. After all, she was the eldest daughter, the first child, the most spoiled.
The second and youngest didn’t have princess sickness at all; it was all concentrated on Nancy. She was also spoiled and had a temper no less than Ruth’s.

As an elder, Ruth immediately put on airs and pretended to be annoyed, "How can that be? The good car should be for your wife to drive. Mom is already this age; driving that practice commuter car is enough."

Lily immediately smiled and said, "Mom, I’m a new driver; there will definitely be a lot of scratches. The parking space at our unit is small and hard to park. It’s more practical to buy a small, cheap one."
"Besides, we’re a family. The car is bought for whoever needs it to drive. Why distinguish so clearly!"
Nancy immediately praised, "Mom, Lily is right. Why distinguish so clearly? This is Luis’s filial piety."
After saying that, they all looked at Luis. Even Nancy’s eyes showed some appreciation. After all, Luis was devoted to her biological mother.

When it came to the influence of toxic chicken soup and the factors of green tea attributes, Luis now felt that after living under the same roof with women for a long time, he had gained a lot of experience.

Luis immediately waved his hand, skillfully saying, "Mom, don’t look at me. I’m only responsible for making money. As for how to spend the money, that’s up to Lily. I, a live-in son-in-law, still have self-awareness."

Ruth immediately frowned and said, "What nonsense are you talking about? What live-in son-in-law? Our family isn’t old-fashioned; there’s no such thing as marrying out or marrying in. You two being together is a small family."
Nancy even agreed, "Exactly, what era is this? Why are you still saying this? How outdated."
Luis said innocently, "But that’s what was said when I got married. It’s a fact. Besides, I didn’t give a bride price."

This time, he was secretly making trouble again. When Daniel married his wife, he didn’t give much of a bride price either. According to custom, the betrothal money spent was just a drop in the bucket.

Besides, I didn’t give a bride price."
This time, he was secretly making trouble again.
When Daniel married his wife, he didn’t give much of a bride price either.
According to custom, the betrothal money spent was just a drop in the bucket.

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Spanish
paragraphs: Nancy’s expression shifted slightly, but seeing that Luis didn’t appear to be making any insinuations, she relaxed.

She had always shared the same impression of Luis as her second sister did, that he was a quiet, simple-minded, kind-hearted but socially awkward person. She never would have imagined that after Luis obtained the System, he would change so dramatically. Or perhaps, this kind of meticulous thinking was Luis’s true nature all along.
Nancy chimed in to support him, "Exactly, what’s all this about a bride price? Our family isn’t selling our daughter. When I got married, your brother-in-law didn’t pay a bride price either."
As soon as Daniel heard this, his expression changed, and he looked quite annoyed as he lit a cigarette fiercely.

However, no one paid him any attention at that moment. Ruth continued cheerfully, "That’s right, a live-in son-in-law is even closer. Since your father is never around, you’re the man of the house, the pillar of the family."
"People always laughed at me for not having a son, but you are my son."

The more she spoke, the more energized Ruth became. She snorted and said, "What’s so great about having sons? If they’re useless and just leech off their parents, the old folks will have to work themselves to death. Expecting those good-for-nothing sons to be filial is just a pipe dream."
"Having that kind of good-for-nothing son, even ten of them are useless. They’re not as caring and considerate as my one son-in-law."
Watching the mother and daughter getting along so affectionately, both full of praise for Luis, laughing and chatting happily, Daniel suddenly felt like an outsider.

Hearing this, Daniel’s face turned ashen. He was the very definition of a leech, and he even brought his wife along to leech off his parents quite happily. When Ruth fired off that broad generalization, he suddenly found himself as the precise target.
In truth, Ruth wasn’t that calculating and was definitely not targeting him specifically, but he was the only one present who could fit that description.
He wouldn’t go so far as to confront his mother-in-law, but seeing Luis being doted on and treated like the favorite just made him furious. His mind quickly worked, and he soon came up with an idea.
Daniel immediately said in a sarcastic tone, "I must have misjudged you. I never expected my brother-in-law to be a hidden wealthy man too."

As soon as he spoke, Luis knew he was up to something new again. Luis thought coldly to himself, you spoiled heir still won’t give up? With all the experience and strength I’ve gained from putting up with your mother-in-law’s temper under the same roof, you’re nothing but a speck of dust to me.
"Not at all, I just like to keep busy, like to tinker with things," Luis said dismissively.

"Brother-in-law probably knows my family background is a bit tragic. Since I was little, I haven’t been loved by my father or mother. If I don’t earn more money, I don’t feel secure. I’m just destined to work hard," Luis added.
Hearing this, the eyes of the mother and her two daughters suddenly softened. Luis’s background stirred up their maternal instincts again.
Daniel actually didn’t know much. He had only vaguely heard that Luis’s original family was a mess, that he was penniless and someone Daniel could bully.
He was always either playing new games or out partying at night, busy leaching off his parents and figuring out how much property they had. He never had the time to care about anything else.
But Daniel still stubbornly said, "That’s not how it is. Some people are just born with a wretched fate. They work hard because they have no brains and can’t earn much money anyway.

Saying something like this at this point clearly showed a lack of brains and emotional intelligence. Not only did Lily and her mother look somewhat angry, but even Nancy frowned, thinking he wasn’t thinking before he spoke.
This small barbecue shop had its door wide open. Suddenly, urgent arguing could be heard from outside.

The funniest part was that it was accompanied by a stream of foreign language. Given the World Wide habit of never missing a chance to watch drama, not only did Lily and her two sisters immediately run out, but even the tense Daniel ran out as well.
"Ding... Two random blind boxes in exchange for one exclusive innate skill. Would you like to exchange?"
Luis had just stood up and was a bit confused. "Two for one? What’s going on?"
The System’s voice continued to ring out:

"Exclusive innate skills are more advanced than the outdated System’s specialized skills. They are directly implanted into the brain as memories, granting the host the most needed skill at this moment."
"What skill?"
"Comprehensive Spanish proficiency (including dialects)."
Luis was even more confused now. "This, is it useful right now???"
The System thoughtfully reminded him, "This skill, in this current scenario, will help increase the favorability meter. Would you like to exchange?"
Based on their previous interactions, it was clear that the System was a high-level virus that parasitically resided within its host and would not harm him.
"Exchange."
"Two random blind boxes fused, exchanged for Comprehensive Spanish proficiency (activated)."

With a buzzing sensation, Luis immediately felt a flood of information pouring into his mind. It felt as though this knowledge had always belonged to him, requiring little adaptation to become second nature.
Running downstairs, he could see the boss’s wife, Auntie Fatty, looking very anxious, wearing an apron and explaining something.

On the other side was a group of foreign men and women, sitting together chattering away, but Auntie Fatty couldn’t understand them at all. The scene looked chaotic, though it wasn’t exactly a conflict, but the mutual misunderstanding certainly made it sound like an argument.
Auntie Fatty had a loud voice, and the white foreigners were also loud, which was the main reason for the commotion.

"Auntie Fatty, don’t worry, let me ask what’s going on," Luis immediately pushed through the crowd, stepped forward, and started communicating with the foreigner who knew a few broken phrases of English.
As soon as Luis opened his mouth, it was with authentic Spanish, flowing naturally without any need for switching modes.
This was clearly another language, but it felt just as effortless for Luis.
As soon as Luis spoke, the foreigner looked as if he had found a savior and kept talking, while Luis nodded and continued the conversation.
The Wood mother and daughters were stunned. Even Daniel was dumbfounded. As a standard university graduate, he could tell Luis wasn’t just putting on a show.
After chatting for a bit, Luis turned to Auntie Fatty and said, "Auntie, he said he’s eaten here before. He asked why the grilled preserved eggs you used to have are no longer on the menu."

"That, they didn’t sell well, so I took them off the menu," Auntie Fatty said excitedly before addressing the other customers, "It’s nothing, it’s nothing. Someone here can communicate with them now. Everyone, please continue eating. There’s no drama to watch here, it’s not a fight."
Luis and the white old man were chatting away enthusiastically. This scene was undoubtedly a spectacle, even if it was a bit anticlimactic.
Nancy whispered, "Lily, your husband’s Spanish is that good?"
Lily was also puzzled, but the evidence was right before her eyes. After being mocked by her eldest sister for so many years, she naturally felt a bit of resentment.

Although she wasn’t a vain person, Lily felt quite proud at this moment and said, "Luis loves studying. He has a bunch of phones and computers but doesn’t play games or watch videos. He’s always studying. Sometimes when he goes upstairs to study, I don’t even dare disturb him."
Ruth couldn’t help but ask, "My son-in-law stays upstairs cooped up in his room studying all the time?"

Lily felt extremely satisfied at that moment and seized the opportunity to say, "Yes, that’s why I don’t dare disturb him while he’s studying. When he wears headphones, it’s not to listen to music or comedy shows—it’s purely for studying."
This explanation seemed to make sense of their previous stereotypical impression that Luis was neglectful toward Lily.
Mainly, in any family, as long as it’s not dysfunctional or abnormal, studying diligently is highly praised, regardless of what you’re learning.

While Luis, Sophia, Lily, and Ruth were still looking both shocked and pleasantly surprised, Luis had already spoken to Aunt Fatty, "Auntie, he’s been here to eat a few times before, and what left the deepest impression on him was the eggs."
As soon as Aunt Fatty heard this, she immediately directed a young worker beside her to go buy century eggs, then said boldly, "So he’s a regular! Then the grilled eggs are on me."
At that moment, the foreigner exchanged a few words with his colleagues, then came up and put his arm around Luis’s shoulder, saying a bunch more.

After listening, Luis laughed and said, "He’s asking about the old food truck that used to park next door—the one that sold fried cheese curds. Why isn’t it around anymore? He came all this way hoping to try it again."
"They moved down by the main intersection. Got themselves a proper storefront now. No problem, I’ll have someone run and grab some," the restaurant owner said with a grin.
Luis translated smoothly for the older tourist, then picked up a menu and started helping them place their order.
Once the fried cheese curds were brought out, the whole table of foreigners cheered. Luis chatted with them a little longer before finally heading back to the private dining room.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Blockchain Gaslighting
paragraphs: Daniel’s face was already stormy with irritation. The restaurant owner quickly followed after Luis, carrying out a big platter of prime rib strips for the grill, laughing warmly:
"Ruth, your son-in-law really saved me today. Without him, I’d have been in a real mess. This one’s on the house—please, don’t turn it down."
"Aiyo, we’re neighbors, how can you call it a favor."
"Not at all. Which family around here doesn’t have a college graduate? But how many of them are truly capable?"

Aunt Fatty put down the complimentary tripe, laughing heartily as she said, "But your son-in-law’s skill level is just too awesome. Someone was criticizing his education background before—what bullshit. Lack of a diploma isn’t important; lack of culture is what’s scary."
After all this commotion, the way the mother and three daughters looked at Luis had changed. They increasingly felt that Luis was exceptionally cultured.

Daniel, however, was furious watching Luis steal the spotlight and couldn’t help but say, "If Luis is so capable and has earned so much money, how come he didn’t think of buying a car back when Mom was being wronged?"
This statement sounded very reasonable. The problem was, after this incident, the attitudes of the mother and three daughters were no longer influenced by any preconceived notions.
Especially the look in the Mother In Law’s eyes when she glanced over—it held no doubt anymore, as if she was certain her second son-in-law would provide a satisfactory answer.

Luis lit a cigarette and said lightly, "Brother-in-law, all these things that happened today—you didn’t know about them either, but that doesn’t mean I did. How many years has it been since I married into the family?"
"I didn’t understand the wrongs Mom suffered. A live-in son-in-law like me has to keep his head down; how could I inquire about so much?"
"As for things like cars, no one ever told me."
Luis added with a chuckle, "But you, Brother-in-law, as the favored eldest son-in-law, you should have reminded me about these things."

This statement, using retreat as advance, was almost pointing a finger and cursing him outright: You, the eldest son-in-law from a well-off family, didn’t handle this, and now you have the nerve to ask me?
It’s hard to generalize about women when it comes to major right and wrong, but when it comes to trivial matters, they will absolutely keep things crystal clear.
Sure enough, Nancy’s delicate eyebrows furrowed. "Daniel, this can’t really be Luis’s fault, can it? Even I didn’t know the specific situation at home after I married out."

Seeing even his wife defect, Daniel almost felt like vomiting blood. He immediately said, "That’s not what I meant. I meant that since he has money now, how could he let your mom suffer these wrongs and only bring up buying a car now?"
"It’s been two years, right? With that money, why pretend to be poor..."
This once again seemed to hit a key point. No matter how foolish Daniel might be, his ability to grasp the main point was relatively strong.

However, he underestimated one thing: Luis, who had always lived under someone else’s roof and endured constant mistreatment, might seem like a quiet gourd, but in reality, he had far more cunning than Daniel. Their different upbringings dictated this; it was impossible for someone like Luis to harbor the naive notions of those who’ve lived privileged lives.
Moreover, Luis knew how to cater to their preferences. His method of dealing with Daniel was like using a blunt knife to cut meat—ensuring Daniel felt uncomfortable every time he picked a fight.

Luis sighed and said, "When I got married, it wasn’t that I had no money. At that time, policies in various countries were changing rapidly, and many blockchain assets were experiencing violent fluctuations. It wasn’t a good time; I had to wait and observe."
"Besides those, there were also overseas investments. The amount wasn’t huge, but it was all real money."
"Just like this current 50,000 dollar withdrawal. If I didn’t cash it out, it might only be 40,000 dollars by the time we finish this meal."

"Those investments from a few days ago were sitting there. Plus, some contracts can’t be withdrawn; they have time limits and involve leverage. Brother-in-law probably doesn’t understand these things."
"To put it simply, that stock I have is worth 400,000 dollars now, but in six months, it’ll be 600,000 dollars."
"As for cashing this out, if I don’t sell, 50,000 dollars could drop to less than 10,000 dollars in a month."
"Some are more complicated. Two years ago, it was worth less than 10,000 dollars, and now it’s about 360,000 dollars, and I can’t bear to sell it."

Adopting a tone of admitting fault, Luis immediately said with a chuckle, "This might be a bit hard to understand. In short, I’m a money grubber. The past few years were a stable period where I couldn’t move things."
"It’s all about profit margins, really. Actually, the money in the stock market isn’t that much either..."
"Mainly blockchain, various contracts..."

Luis pretended to blank out for a moment, then immediately said with a laugh, "Let’s not talk about this anymore. It’s too exhausting. Some things involve accumulating little into much, others involve making money from foreign exchange rate differences—it’s all a bit messy."

Hearing this, Ruth, who already held him in high esteem, directly slammed the table. "What are you asking all this for? What do any of you understand? How many times have I told you all? It’s not that we’re saying women can’t do things, but if you can’t earn money yourself, don’t stand to the side talking nonsense."
"Luis had no money before, right? But he invested all his hard-earned money and didn’t squander it. From the time he married Lily until now, he hasn’t been to a bar even once."
"Now that he has money, he’s spending it on his wife, on me, his Mother In Law, what’s the problem with that? So much nonsense."
After this continuous output, Daniel picked up his car keys and left, without even saying goodbye to his Mother In Law.

Ruth directly cursed, pointing at Nancy and saying, "You see? This is what you call a highly educated family? He left without even saying a word to me. Is he mentally ill? Does our whole family have to fawn over him?"
Furious, Nancy called him, but he hung up immediately.
She was also extremely angry and immediately tried to soothe her, "Mom, don’t be angry. He’s just been spoiled rotten. He’s the petty type."
Ruth snorted and said, "I can see that. Really no upbringing. Tell him to learn more from Luis in the future. smart, low-key, and knows how to care for people."
Nancy suddenly asked, "By the way, Luis, how do you know so much?"
"Stock Education is foundational. Useless without it. But it’s also exhausting. I have to get up in the middle of the night to look at all kinds of data.
By this point, Luis naturally couldn’t avoid showing off a bit.
After eating and drinking their fill and paying the bill, Nancy seemed to look at him differently.

Annoyingly, the mission related to her still hadn’t been triggered. What the hell? Luis was eagerly looking forward to putting a green hat on Daniel, to properly vent the resentment he’d accumulated over the years.

As they were leaving, the table of foreigners at the entrance was drinking joyously. They insistently pulled Luis into a very lively conversation. After having a few drinks and exchanging contact information for the future, Luis finally left.
Nancy was staying at her parents’ house today. Given Daniel’s attitude today, with her temper, she wouldn’t indulge him.
Luis and Lily were already habitually holding hands, fingers interlaced. Lily, looking blissful and intoxicated, hugged her husband’s arm, chatting and laughing happily with her mother.
Nancy suddenly asked, "Luis, what were those foreigners saying earlier that got them so excited?"
"Oh... they’re here on a business inspection trip. The translator their group sent turns out he’s half-baked and completely useless—got chewed out and sent back."
"They asked if I could be their translator. One thousand dollars a day."
Ruth’s eyes lit up. "Goodness, that’s 30,000 dollars a month then..."
"That’s way better than being some crappy accountant! And still needing connections? Pah! Really treating the three of us women like fools."
Stimulated by alcohol, Ruth didn’t hold back even with her eldest daughter. "Nancy, you’ve been fooled by him. That guy’s mouth can really say anything."
Nancy sighed but didn’t refute it. One’s own matters are only known to oneself.
Seeing his sister-in-law’s melancholy and somewhat helpless appearance, perhaps she also felt some regret. Luis was inwardly anxious, wondering why the mission still hadn’t been released.
Damn it, his heart was utterly sincere in its eagerness to cuckold Daniel.

Upon arriving home, Nancy wiped the sweat from her little nose and said, "It’s so hot, Mom. We really should install an air conditioner in the living room. Our living room isn’t that big, and if we just close the kitchen sliding door, it’ll get nice and cool."
The Wood family’s oddly shaped duplex was indeed quite small. A low-power standing air conditioner would definitely be sufficient.
After hearing her daughter’s words, Ruth rolled her eyes directly and said, "Things don’t just appear by flapping your lips. How about you and Lily split the cost, half each?"
"I’ll have to wait until the end of the month. I told you I’m short on cash right now."
When the topic turned to money, Nancy became a bit irritable, her face showing clear helplessness.

Nancy joked, "Sounds like there’s more to what you’re saying. Implying that Mom and I aren’t diligent, and if Lily doesn’t get up, there won’t be anyone to cook in this house, right?"
"I didn’t mean that at all, Sister. Don’t wrongly accuse me. I’ll go buy breakfast, how about that?

After exchanging a few jokes, they went downstairs. Ruth provided the number for the scrap collector here before heading to the teahouse, while Luis and Nancy contacted the local housekeeping service.
"Let’s eat first, then just pack something for her to eat later!"

"Who knows when she’ll wake up? Anything bought now will be cold and unappetizing later, and noodles will turn soggy."
Luis took her to the market, specifically buying ribs, cilantro (Lily’s favorite), and two plump, juicy abalones.

But seeing Luis humming a little tune while busily working, it didn’t seem put on. Besides, both her mom and sister had said yesterday that Luis was actually very gentle and considerate, especially her sister, who looked so happy it made Nancy doubt her own perceptions.
"Sister, please wait a bit. It’ll be ready to eat soon."
Luis said with a smile, "Try my cooking. At the very least, I’m not as stingy as Lily when buying groceries."
"Haha, that’s true!"
"That lazy girl. The scrap collector will be here soon. I’ll go wake her up."
"Don’t, Sister. Let her sleep a bit more."
"Nonsense. Don’t spoil her so much."
Nancy charged upstairs, her face clearly twisted with jealousy.

He’d never experienced hardship or setbacks and was naively foolish. His personality was a bit chuunibyou and silly, leading to frequent arguments. And when they argued, he never gave in to her.
Even though Nancy dressed stylishly, she had to handle all the housework because Daniel was the type who wouldn’t lift a finger even if the soy sauce bottle tipped over.

Nancy could actually cook quite well, being the eldest sister who’d taken on a motherly role, but she simply didn’t want to wait on Daniel. The couple ate out or ordered takeout every day, and their home was filled with snacks and instant noodles.

As for housework, Nancy initially slacked off out of anger, but she found she couldn’t outlast Daniel. Clothes piled up like a mountain? He just wouldn’t wash them—his mom had bought him plenty of clothes to wear.
When the house got too dirty, they’d call a housekeeping service. Even if Daniel had no money, he’d still find a way to manage it.

This life idiot, this idle good-for-nothing, had completely worn Nancy down. Plus, Arthur, with his chauvinistic views, also never cooked. So, she felt quite favorably impressed seeing Luis so skillfully working in the kitchen.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Leah Is Back
paragraphs: Watching her go upstairs, Luis revealed a meaningful smile.

This was exactly the effect he wanted. Even though the mission related to his sister-in-law hadn’t started yet, it was always good to prepare in advance and plan ahead. The key was to target her pain points and stimulate her.
"Hubby, morning! What are we eating?"
Not long after, Lily, having brushed her teeth and washed her face, came downstairs in her athletic wear. She hugged Luis from behind, looking very happy.
"Pig feed. You slept like a pig."
Luis turned his head and kissed her. Lily was both shy and delighted.
Just then, Nancy came downstairs and saw this scene. Her feelings were utterly mixed, and her gaze turned somewhat strange, as if lost in thought.
"Sister, please sit down. It’ll be ready to eat soon."
"Wow, seafood congee! Hubby, you’re amazing..."
"Stinky hubby, this braised pork intestine—I’m blindly guessing it’s from the stall at the very end of the market."
"So talkative. Help me get the bowls."

The stall at the very end of the market was the most expensive. Its location wasn’t great, but it had the best business because the taste was excellent. If you went too late, you’d almost certainly miss out.
Nancy sat on the sofa but had no idea what was playing on the TV. When she turned her head, she saw Luis and Lily talking intimately while both busied themselves with tasks, looking very happy.
The harmony of husband and wife preparing food together appeared especially affectionate. For a moment, Nancy felt dazed.
This should be what marriage is about... the most beautiful scene of a man and woman together out of love. Everything felt natural and ordinary, yet particularly pleasing to the eye.
"Sister, time to eat!"
Aside from a pot of seafood congee, there was also braised pork intestine, several types of pickles, and sliced salted duck eggs. For a home meal, it was quite lavish.
"Delicious! Hubby, you worked hard!"
Lily giggled while eating and then recommended, "Sister, try it! Luis’s congee is absolutely top-notch."
"Not bad!"

Nancy replied simply, but she also had a hearty appetite and ate more than usual. The strangest thing was that meals at her own home weren’t this lavish. Before she married, whether Ruth cooked or she did, they never paid this much attention to detail.
A glance into the kitchen revealed many different seasonings, suggesting that Luis wasn’t just cooking on a whim but had been doing it regularly.
"They’re here, they’re here!"
Just as they finished eating, the scrap collector arrived. Luis got up first to open the door.
"Lily, you take them upstairs. I’ll clear the table."
Luis then said, "Sister, please supervise. Sell everything, including those air conditioners..."
"Including the air conditioners??"
Even Lily was startled.
"Those old air conditioners are inefficient and consume too much electricity. They definitely need to go. Saving a little money isn’t worth the high electricity bills.
Luis pointed toward the master bedroom. "Even Mom’s needs to be replaced."
Nancy thought for a moment and, unusually, offered proactively, "Luis, you and Lily go handle your things. I’ll clear the table and wash the dishes."
Luis, while clearing the table, stopped her and said with a smile, "Sister, you go with Lily. Deal with that pile of junk yourselves. Just remember one thing: empty all the rooms for me."
"Hubby, you’re the best!"
Lily was overjoyed and gave Luis a kiss.
Nancy’s eyes sparkled with eager excitement. It was clear how much the three sisters detested those junk items.
Luis continued humming a little tune while doing household chores. The two sisters went upstairs with the scrap collector. Nancy couldn’t help but ask, "Lily, does he do housework at home too?"
"Why wouldn’t he?"
Lily was momentarily stunned, then understood what was going on. She snorted. "Sister and Mom are just biased against him. I know it."
"Mom hasn’t done laundry in years. When I’m tired or on my period, Luis does the housework. Last time during the big cleanup upstairs, even wiping the hallway was his job."
"He didn’t go into your room or little sister’s out of respect for you. Why does Sister think my husband has so many flaws?"

In reality, it only happened once or twice a year, but the more Lily thought about it, the happier she felt. Whether compared to the old Luis or that good-for-nothing brother-in-law of hers, the current Luis was definitely a good man.
"I... I didn’t mean it like that!"
For the first time, Nancy felt a bit embarrassed in front of her.
"First, clear out all that stuff. Have little sister come back and pack her own things."
After saying this, Luis went out. Nancy’s eyes held a touch of soft affection. "He’s specifically going to pick little sister up too?"
Lily said with a proud smile, "Luis has always been very considerate and respectful. He said last night that little sister has grown up, and we need to respect her privacy too."
"I really couldn’t tell before!"
Nancy was slightly surprised. Almost against her will, she couldn’t help but compare her brother-in-law to her own husband.
Her previous sense of superiority, the reasons she had looked down on this brother-in-law—all seemed like prejudice and ignorance now.

Actually, Leah could have come back on her own by now, but to be more considerate and also to have a bit of couple time, Luis specifically went to pick her up. Mainly because asking for leave required Luis, as her guardian, to do it.
"Brother in law!"
Leah already knew about this through Whatsapp. As soon as she left the school gate, she cautiously asked, "Brother in law, what reason did you give for asking for leave?"
"I told the teacher that your eldest sister’s husband was in a car accident..."
"You’re so mean."
In the taxi, she felt a bit shy. After returning to the community, they kept running into people, and as a result, there wasn’t a single chance for them to be alone. Luis was extremely frustrated.

They worked hard all afternoon, disposing of all the junk Ruth couldn’t bear to throw away. They also got rid of the old furniture from all three rooms, practically clearing out the entire second floor.
It wasn’t until 5 p.m. that Ruth, having finished playing cards, hurried back first.
The entire second floor was completely cleared out and felt very empty. The two small rooms looked much more spacious. Ruth couldn’t help but sigh.
The fierce mother-in-law frowned and couldn’t resist asking, "You all have too much free time. Why did you hire people instead of just cleaning it yourselves?"

The housekeeping company had sent four people who were cleaning all the rooms, including the bathroom. The three Wood sisters were holed up in the master bedroom chatting. Ruth naturally found it hard to accept.
"Mom, it was Luis who told us not to do it."

Lily said cautiously, "He said deep cleaning requires professionals from a housekeeping company and told us not to get our hands dirty, that the weather is too hot and we shouldn’t exhaust ourselves."
Nancy also said cheerfully, "Mom, our brother-in-law is doting on his wife, and we’re benefiting from it too."
"Mom, you’re back!"
Just then, Luis walked in from outside, holding a box of fruit platter. He said with a smile, "Perfect timing to have some fruit. It’s so hot today."
"Long live my husband!"
"Long live brother-in-law!"
The deluxe fruit platter contained not only chilled watermelon but also premium-grade cherries, milk strawberries, and other expensive items.
Ruth felt heartache seeing it and said, "Son-in-law, this must have cost quite a bit. You’re spoiling them too much."
"Eldest sister, I specially picked out a box of the best strawberry for you."
Luis also took out a box of durian.
"Thank you..."

Nancy took it, feeling a bit surprised. She didn’t know how her brother-in-law found out she loved strawberry. Come to think of it, Daniel always complained that strawberry was expensive and didnt taste good. He never bought it for her and didn’t allow her to eat it at home.

The mother and her four daughters ate the fruit. Looking at this beautiful scene where each had her own charms—some plump, some slender—Luis felt a surge of warmth in his heart. He secretly vowed to turn this home into his den of debauchery... ahem, his harem.
"Mom, we’ll split into two groups tonight."
Luis made orderly arrangements, "You three go take measurements and then pick out new furniture at the furniture mall."

After thinking for a moment, Nancy suddenly said, "Mom, since Lily and the others are moving into the master bedroom, why not break down the partition between the two small rooms? That way, the other room will be bigger too."
"Why?"
Ruth was somewhat surprised.

Even sensible Leah said, "Eldest sister, after clearing out the stuff, my room is plenty big. If we break down the wall, there will only be one room left. It wouldn’t be convenient for you when you come back to stay after arguing with brother-in-law in the future."
"Pfft, I rarely come back. Now that I am back, I mostly sleep with Mom anyway, so there’s no need to specially keep a room for me."
Nancy said with a smile, "If needed, I can just sleep with you!"
"These two small rooms are only separated by a wooden board. There’s no soundproofing at all. You can hear every word of a phone call clearly. There’s really no need for it."

Ruth felt somewhat conflicted. Initially, the knockoff renovation upstairs was done so that each daughter could have her own room. Although she was controlling and unreasonable, at least she had awareness in this aspect.

After thinking for a moment, Nancy suddenly said, "Mom, since Lily and the others are moving into the master bedroom, why not break down the partition between the two small rooms?
That way, the other room will be bigger too."
"Why?"
Ruth was somewhat surprised.
Even sensible Leah said, "Eldest sister, after clearing out the stuff, my room is plenty big.
If we break down the wall, there will only be one room left.
It wouldn’t be convenient for you when you come back to stay after arguing with brother-in-law in the future."
"Pfft, I rarely come back.
Now that I am back, I mostly sleep with Mom anyway, so there’s no need to specially keep a room for me."
Nancy said with a smile, "If needed, I can just sleep with you!"
"These two small rooms are only separated by a wooden board.
There’s no soundproofing at all.
You can hear every word of a phone call clearly.
There’s really no need for it."
Ruth felt somewhat conflicted.
Initially, the knockoff renovation upstairs was done so that each daughter could have her own room.
Although she was controlling and unreasonable, at least she had awareness in this aspect.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: This Double Standard Is A Bit Too Much
paragraphs: "Son-in-law, what do you think?"
Subtly influenced, Ruth looked at Luis, feeling that he should make the decision.

When she said this, the three Wood sisters also looked at Luis together, seemingly having already acknowledged his position as the head of the household. At this moment, Lily smiled even more happily.
Luis sat cross-legged on the floor, smoking with an ashtray set out.

This showed his elevated status in the household. In the past, he would have been scolded for smoking in the living room, but now he could smoke right in his mother-in-law’s room, and none of the four had any objections.
"I think it’s fine too!"
Luis said cheerfully, "It’s up to you sisters to discuss and decide. Mainly, Leah spends most of her time at school, and eldest sister doesn’t come back to stay often either."
"Alright, then let’s find someone to tear it down!"

Merging the two small rooms into one means the upstairs will only have two master bedrooms and one bathroom. The happiest is naturally Leah, because her living environment has been significantly upgraded.
After chatting for a while, Luis received a call from the appliance flagship store downstairs.

As soon as the housekeeping staff left, several workers immediately came upstairs to remove the old air conditioners. At the same time, the craftsmen found downstairs also came to dismantle the plywood, working with high efficiency.
"Honey, what did you mean earlier about splitting into two groups?"
Lily finally asked.
Luis said with a smile, "In a bit, you three sisters will go to the furniture mall and pick out the furniture you like. If delivery tonight is too rushed, have it delivered tomorrow morning."

"Mom and I will wait at home for the air conditioners to be installed and debugged. Also, the craftsmen will come tonight to remove the wooden wall. After it’s taken down, we’ll apply a little paint so it won’t delay the furniture assembly tomorrow."
As he spoke, Luis directly transferred 5,000 dollars to his wife. Lily looked surprised and said, "Honey, that’s too much."
"For our own home, choose better quality."

Luis also affectionately patted his sister-in-law Leah’s head and said very seriously, "Being frugal and managing the household well is a virtue, but since the money is being spent, don’t be too calculating. Let Leah choose whatever bed and desk she wants. You two, as older sisters, are not allowed to criticize her."

This was preemptive, as Leah was at the bottom of the family hierarchy. When it came to spending money, not only would Nancy, being the eldest sister like a mother, manage her, but even the usually gentle Lily would certainly lecture her.
Leah giggled flirtatiously, "Thank you, brother in law. Long live brother in law. If there is the slightest movement, I will definitely report it to you."
"Pick a larger wardrobe. At the very least, big sister needs to place some pajamas and underwear at home."
"No need!"
Ruth, with her straightforward personality, immediately spoke up, "I need to clear out some of my clothes too. The wardrobe on mother’s side is big. When the time comes, just put them in my place."
"Alright, you all go shop on your own!
"Husband, what will you and mother eat then?"
"We’ll just buy boxed meals later."

The truth was, someone really needed to stay home. Besides the craftsmen breaking down the walls, the air conditioning had also started being installed. Moreover, the housekeeping staff hadn’t left after cleaning the second floor; they were now doing a deep clean of the kitchen and bathrooms downstairs.
After the three sisters went out, Ruth, who had just been acting composed, suddenly felt a bit awkward. Her voice trembling, she said, "I’ll go down to buy the boxed meals."
"Mother, no rush!"
Luis grabbed her hand. Ruth’s breathing became rapid, and she was very nervous. She tried to shake it off but couldn’t break free.
The housekeeping staff were all downstairs, and they would see each other often. Ruth didn’t dare struggle or speak, her face flushed red as she looked at Luis.
"Let go, there are so many people at home..."
"Mother!"
Just as Luis wanted to cherish this moment alone with her, a housekeeping staff member came out to discuss how to clean the refrigerator.

The moment he loosened his grip, Ruth immediately ran upstairs. Luis was extremely frustrated, but there was nothing he could do. With so many people around and so many eyes at home, it really wasn’t the right time to flirt with his mother in law.
Extremely frustrated, Luis sat down and lit a cigarette. Just then, a Whatsapp notification sounded. It was a message from his mother in law, Ruth:

"Son in law, that night we both made a mistake because we had too much to drink. We are a family living under the same roof. I can see how much Lily loves you, and mother is also very happy to see you two so deeply in love. Let’s forget that dream. We shouldn’t be like that!!"
Luis smiled as he read it. His mother in law’s education level seemed to fluctuate. In the past, that shrew would always curse, quick to anger and swear. Now she seemed quite refined and really cute.
Who would agree to such a request? Luis pondered how to reply to this message.

Suddenly, another Whatsapp notification sounded. It was a video sent by his sister in law, Leah. The background showed her two older sisters walking ahead after dinner, while she played the role of a follower from behind.
"Lily, it feels like Luis is a completely different person."
"Not really. He’s always been like this. There’s no difference."

"Today, he arranged everything so methodically, and the timing was perfect too. Everything was orderly, and we were all very relaxed. If mother had handled this, we would have been exhausted to death."
"Big sister, I’ve long said you were biased against him before. Luis just doesn’t like to boast, but he’s actually very smart, okay."
"Stop showing off your husband. We know he’s great, alright!
"I just didn’t expect that today he specifically went to pick little sister up and bring her back."
"Luis already said it. Little sister has grown up, and we as older sisters should respect her. Let her tidy up her own things."
"Little sister, you should be grateful to your second brother in law. None of us thought about this matter; only he remembered it."
The video ended here. Leah didn’t send anything else, nor any emojis or the like, but the meaning was self-evident.

Luis smiled. He hadn’t expected that the three sisters would all be each other’s divine helpers, and that they would actually say such nice things behind his back. It was quite surprising. It could be said that thanks to the mother’s role as the antagonist, they appeared very united.
Lost in his thoughts, Luis immediately received another video from his sister in law, also secretly recorded, but the setting had changed to a furniture store:
"Lily, honestly, neither of you are big spenders. Why did you buy that bracelet and even get two for mother? That adds up to over 10,000 dollars, right?"

"Luis suddenly bought it. I was a bit surprised too. Maybe it’s my fault. This series is too trendy; many women at our hospital wear it. I just mentioned it two or three times, and he secretly bought it for me."
"Nonsense, you’re just showing off. You said it, and your husband remembered. But why did you buy one for mother??"
"What’s wrong with buying for mother? Aunt Yana is always boasting, and it must bother mother. That teahouse is full of bitches; who can stand it?"

At this point, Lily was clearly bragging again, shaking her head as she said, "Luis doesn’t understand these things. He went and asked for the most expensive one. As a result, that bracelet was as heavy as handcuffs. Mother wanted to show off but said her wrist ached, so Luis bought her a cheaper one!!"
Leah, who had been secretly recording the video, spoke up first, "That’s not right. Brother in law is such a frugal person. He spent that much money??"
Lily said, both crying and laughing, "Your brother-in-law isn’t frugal!"
Leah said seriously, "Brother in law’s clothes are all free T shirts with logos. His underwear is almost all torn and full of holes."
Lily smiled even more happily. Nancy seemed a bit jealous and asked, "You seem to have an opinion. Did brother in law skimp on paying your tuition fees, you little ingrate?"
Leah giggled, "Not at all. Brother in law is very generous. I was just thinking about why brother in law is so stingy with himself."

Lily sighed, "That’s just how he is. If I want to buy clothes and it costs a thousand, he’d say I shouldn’t have called to ask him. But for himself... he’d just casually wear underwear that costs a few dollars."
"I know about that, Mom couldn’t stand it anymore and bought him several new outfits."
Leah laughed heartily: "Brother-in-law bought Mom jewelry worth seven or eight thousand dollars, then Mom bought him clothes worth a few hundred dollars, and he even scolded her for wasting money."
"This double standard is a bit too much."
Even Nancy widened her eyes in surprise.

Leah, however, suddenly spoke with full confidence: "Brother-in-law is the kind of person who would walk miles to eat a five-dollar bowl of plain noodles, but when it comes to our family needing money, he won’t allow us to save a single cent."

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Temptation
paragraphs: Lily followed with a sigh: "Big sis, I know you all have prejudices against him, but that’s just the kind of person Luis is. He’s extremely frugal with himself, but look at how he spends on us, on the family, on Mom—he never holds back."
"It’s the same with Leah here!"
Lily added: "Your brother-in-law has given instructions. You’re to choose yourself, and he won’t allow Big Sis and me to say anything to you."
"When I asked him how much he spent, he directly said, ’The money spent on my little sister is none of your business.’ But Big Sis knows it definitely wasn’t a small amount."
"Second Sis, I didn’t waste money."
"I know, but with your brother-in-law’s personality, he’s definitely going to buy you the best, unlike before when Mom bought everything cheap."
The video ended here. Leah focused on shopping and didn’t send any more, probably because the little sister-in-law was also deeply moved.
Having a little mole really felt great. Leah sending this video probably made her happy too. Even without any other content, one could still sense the emotions.
This night wasn’t actually steamy at all because installing the new air conditioners wasn’t easy. Removing the old second-hand units was also quite a hassle.

As a result, Luis didn’t get a chance to sneak into his beautiful mother-in-law’s room because, by early morning, the air conditioners in the two upstairs rooms had been replaced, the one in the mother-in-law’s master bedroom had been changed, and the living room had a new one installed.
However, the upstairs was empty and couldn’t be slept in, as the furniture would only be delivered tomorrow, and some new items hadn’t been purchased yet.
"It’s fine, I’ll just sleep in the living room."
The living room had air conditioning, and Luis genuinely wanted to sleep. Mainly because with all three mother and daughters present, there really wasn’t any opportunity for any sneaky activities.

They were chatting enthusiastically, and honestly, if Luis joined them, it would just be awkward. The current situation was that when they were together, they were a complete family. As the live-in son-in-law, his mere presence felt awkward just due to gender dynamics.
However, the advantage of having a little mole soon became apparent:
"What’s going on with Daniel? He’s their only son—don’t they want a grandson? How come your belly still hasn’t shown any signs?"
"Mom, I... actually have some health issues, and Daniel does too. We haven’t sorted it out yet.
Nancy knew how to redirect the focus and immediately said: "By the way, Lily, you two should start thinking about having a child too."
Lily blushed and said: "We’ve talked about it before, but Luis said if we don’t have money, we should wait a while."
Hearing this, Ruth wasn’t pleased: "What kind of plan is that? If you have one, just have it. Once it’s born, raise it. Is he really that meticulous??"

Lily smiled tenderly and said: "Luis didn’t mean it like that. He told me before that he doesn’t feel confident about providing a better future for the child, so he’s hesitating about whether to have one."
"Wait, he lacks confidence?"
Nancy frowned.
"Luis’s own family situation is probably worse than you think."

Lily paused for a moment and said: "Maybe he’s always worried about being a live-in son-in-law. If a child is born, would it have to take the Wood family name? And besides, there’s no one to help take care of it."
"Bullshit, what era is this to still care about that?"

Ruth, who was usually sharp-tongued, was unexpectedly open-minded this time and declared confidently: "Once you have a child, you can decide the surname yourselves. That vixen outside has already given your father a son, so he has no say in this."
"Mom has made the decision, so that’s settled!"
Nancy giggled and said, "Mom, you’re so wise. Lily, you can focus on preparing for pregnancy with peace of mind. By the way, are you and Luis harmonious in the bedroom?"
Lily said shyly: "Big sis, little sister is still here. What nonsense are you talking about?"
"Okay, okay, I won’t say anymore!"

The mother and three daughters couldn’t all fit on one bed, so they made a bed on the floor. Luis was perfectly happy sleeping alone in the living room, enjoying some comfort. As soon as he hung up the call with the little mole, he fell fast asleep.

The next morning, the sound of the mother and three daughters waking up was absolutely chirpy and noisy. Although each of them was beautiful in their own way, when they were together, it was indeed a bit loud.

In the past, Ruth’s fierce demeanor would have made her three daughters reluctant to chat with her for fear of being scolded for no reason. But now, the family atmosphere was harmonious and joyful—though the downside was that it was genuinely a bit noisy.
Mother-in-law Ruth: favorability meter 88%, emotion: conflicted, hesitant.
"Son-in-law, what’s the plan for today?"
Mother-in-law Ruth came over and asked with a charming smile, seemingly thinking that Luis had accepted what she said yesterday since he hadn’t replied to her.
Conflicted and hesitant?? It definitely wasn’t because she wanted to initiate conversation with him. So why was she feeling this way?
Luis pondered for a moment and figured out why. He chuckled and said: "Mom, you can go play your cards as usual. There’s no need for so many people at home."
"You little rascals, are you going to tear the house apart? What, do you think Mom is in the way now?"
Ruth pouted playfully. Seeing her attitude, Luis knew his guess was correct.

The mother-in-law wasn’t exactly lazy or idle. It was true she loved playing cards, but she wasn’t obsessed to the point of madness. She probably had prior plans with Yana and was eager to go show off.
Just then, Leah, who happened to be walking by, stuck out her tongue and made a cute face at Luis, afraid of getting scolded by association, and immediately ran off.
"Mom, your daughters have grown up, and your son-in-law is also at home. It’s not like there’s no one to do the work."
Seeing that no one was around and all three sisters had gone upstairs, Luis mustered his courage and boldly stepped forward, embracing Mother-in-law from behind.
Ruth was so startled she trembled and struggled fiercely, speaking in a panic while glancing toward the staircase, her voice lowered: "Luis, are you crazy? All three of them are home."
"Mom said yesterday that this is wrong, that we shouldn’t continue making mistakes."

Holding her mature, voluptuous body in his arms, even through her clothes, he could feel the full temptation of her seductive flesh. Luis’s hands went straight for her chest, and before Ruth could react, he grabbed her breasts over her bra.
