She bit her silver teeth as if holding back grievance, her eyes slightly reddened.
Though clearly angry, she still took a step back.
"Who are you?"
Luis suddenly felt very irritated.
Seeing her timid and obedient demeanor, he was reminded of the times his wife complained about being bullied during her days as a nurse.
Luis said without courtesy, "I came here to buy from her.
It’s not appropriate for you to overstep like this."
The manager straightened his tie and said with a smile, "Sir, you might not be aware, but Maria is just a summer intern here.
She isn’t even considered a salesperson.
Her usual job is to distribute flyers for our store."
"Today is her last day as a summer intern.
She already completed the offboarding procedures this morning."
"If we were to calculate her sales commission, it would be very troublesome.
Besides, after today, she won’t be working here anymore, so she won’t be able to provide you with proper after-sales service."
Every word sounded reasonable, but it was clearly a blatant attempt to steal the credit.
Originally, Luis didn’t want to meddle in other people’s business, but seeing the helpless, resigned expression on the face of the girl named Maria, he felt a surge of anger.
He looked disdainfully at the well-dressed but shameless man in front of him, glanced at the business card, and sneered, "Manager Connor, right?"
"Yes!
Manager Connor stood up straight again and said, "I can introduce you to other products under our flagship store."
Just then, Maria seemed to have made up her mind.
She gritted her teeth, raised her head, and said, "Manager Connor, I’m not even in your team.
Even if my internship ends today, any sales I make should still count toward our team leader’s performance."
"Both my team leader and I would get credit for the sales.
She’s off today—aren’t you just bullying me like this?"
Manager Connor was momentarily stunned, then sneered, "Maria, I suggest you get your head straight.
You’re just a summer intern.
You have no right to talk to me like that."
"Besides, your completion paperwork was signed yesterday and approved first thing this morning.
Technically, you’re not even staff here anymore.
You have no authority to make sales here."
Maria clenched her silver-white teeth and said, "Our team leader said there were many people absent today and asked me to work an extra day to help you out.
I didn’t even ask for pay for this day, but you can’t treat me like this."
Luis watched with great interest.
Truth be told, you didn’t need some high-society drama to see this kind of thing—petty conflicts like this were common in small workplaces, and he’d seen plenty.
But he was quite impressed with this young girl named Maria.
The last time he visited, Luis was unkempt—wearing faded, cheap denim jeans and a T-shirt with a logo that was clearly handed out for free at some part-time job.
The other salespeople had glanced at him and gone back to their own business without paying him any attention.
Only this young girl named Yang had greeted him warmly.
Even though you shouldn’t judge a book by its cover, in specialty stores like this, people often made assumptions based on appearance.
This girl had been working here as a summer intern for a while and could still be so warm and enthusiastic.
That alone made Luis feel particularly comfortable.
"Then you should take it up with your team leader.
She broke the rules."
Manager Connor smirked and said, "Who asked you to work an extra day?
Do you have any idea how strict our policies are?"
It was obvious he wanted to claim the sales credit and commission for himself.
Maria trembled with anger.
"Manager Connor, just this morning you told me that we were short-handed and thanked me for helping.
You asked me to work until 6 p.m. before leaving."
"Did I say that?
You must be hearing things."
Manager Connor looked down at her and snorted.
Maria was so angry she couldn’t speak.
Just then, several salespeople came over, but it was clear they were all on Manager Connor’s side.
"Maria, why are you being so stubborn?
You’ve already finished your internship and are leaving.
Why make a fuss over such a small thing?"
"Exactly, the sales credit won’t even go to you.
It’s not like you’ll get much money out of it.
What’s there to fight over?"
"You’re just a summer intern, not a full-time employee.
Sales aren’t even your job.
Why are you making such a big deal out of this?"
"Oho, maybe she’s just trying to get the attention of this rich handsome guy and using this as an excuse."
Faced with all the sarcastic comments, Maria gritted her teeth, her eyes already welling up with tears.
Now it was clearly a case of ganging up on her.
Maria, clearly inexperienced in dealing with such situations, was already overwhelmed.
Her hesitant expression showed she was starting to back down.
Manager Connor smiled triumphantly and said, "Since you’re no longer an employee here, get out."
Then, he turned to Luis and said, "I’m sorry, sir.
Please add me on Whatsapp and save my number.
I’ll definitely provide you with the best service."
"But a summer intern causing trouble here?
How outrageous.
We need some time to handle this.
Luis frowned and asked, "Can your supervisor or team leader come back?"
"I, I don’t know!"
"Ask her now."
Maria, flustered and panicked, picked up her phone and made a call.
The moment the call connected, her nervousness was evident.
"Um, Team Leader Blanche, where are you?
Can you come over?
I really need your help with something."
After hanging up, Maria lowered her head, looking both embarrassed and upset.
Manager Connor sneered and said, "How dare she overreach?
A petty team leader thinks she can override me?"
"Take off your employee badge now, remove your uniform, and get out."
"What about my pay?
When will I get it?"
Maria asked through gritted teeth.
"Pay?
What pay?"
Manager Connor chuckled darkly and said, "We never hire temporary workers or summer interns here."
"You can’t bully people like this!"
Tears welled up in Maria’s eyes as she said, "You were the one who said you were hiring summer interns to hand out flyers.
Then you said the store was short-handed and asked me to help with sales too."
"Where’s the proof?
Did we sign any contract with you?"
Manager Connor sneered and said, "You’re not even in our employee records.
As for the flyer distribution gig, you’ve already been paid for that."
"The flyer money only covered the first few days of the month, but I’ve worked all the way until the end of this month."
Tears of frustration streamed down Maria’s face as she said, "You said temporary workers didn’t need contracts.
How can you go back on your word now?"
"Enough.
Stop embarrassing yourself here."
Manager Connor snorted arrogantly and said coldly, "Do you even know what kind of place this is?
If you keep making a scene, I’ll have security throw you out.
Believe me."
"Now I get it.
You’re nothing but a penniless scumbag who even withholds pay from a student working part-time."
Luis finally spoke up, his tone mocking.
Manager Connor’s face immediately darkened, and he retorted rudely, "Don’t you dare accuse me without evidence.
If you claim she worked here, show me the proof."

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Cute And Fierce Maria
paragraphs: "Don’t worry, there will be proof."
Luis took out his phone, answered a call, and said, "David, did you hear that? It’s a pretty petty dispute."
"I’ll be there in five minutes. I’ve already parked."
The person on the phone responded in Spanish, sounding slightly annoyed. Manager Connor was momentarily stunned and instinctively asked, "Who are you calling?"

Luis ignored him. He led Maria, who was biting her lower lip and quietly crying, to the side. Patting her back to comfort her, he said, "Don’t cry. Today, I’ll make sure he pays you every cent you’re owed."

Then he looked up and sneered, "Sometimes authority trumps rules. For flagship stores like yours, formal complaint channels are often too tedious for ordinary people to bother with. But there’s always someone who can put you in your place."
Manager Connor had a sinking feeling.
Just then, a dark-haired man with sharp brown eyes rushed over furiously. He was impeccably dressed, yet cursing, "¡JODER...!"
Manager Connor’s scalp went numb, and his voice trembled as he said, "David, Mr. David."
Manager Connor greeted them in broken Spanish. David rushed over and fist-bumped Luis. The moment Luis opened his mouth and spoke fluent Spanish, both Manager Connor and Maria were stunned.
After a brief exchange, David didn’t bother questioning the other employees and went straight to check the store’s surveillance footage.
Manager Connor was sweating bullets by now. He had just been promoted to manager, and it was David who had promoted him after arriving.
David was a mid-to-high-level executive in this region. His authority over local flagship stores was almost absolute. In fact, with just one report, he could directly fire a store manager.
This guy, Connor, was only the sales manager here, newly promoted and not yet firmly established. He never dreamed that Luis would call his ultimate boss with a single phone call.

In fact, it was a coincidence. That night at Aunt Fatty’s barbecue stall, they had run into this very David. Luis had glanced at his business card and vaguely remembered he was a mid-to-high-level executive in Apple’s division.
Luis had a good habit of saving every number he got, and it had come in handy now.
"FUCK..."
After watching the surveillance footage, David returned and chewed out Manager Connor mercilessly.
Manager Connor’s face turned pale and then flushed, looking as if he had just lost his mother. He probably had never been this meek even in front of his own father.
"Brother, what did that foreigner say?"

Maria was just a temporary worker. She had vaguely seen this foreigner before but didn’t really know who he was. She only knew that whenever he showed up, the entire store went on high alert and became extremely nervous.
Luis found this amusing. Looking at her tear-stained, pitiful face, he took out a tissue and gently wiped her tears.
The intimate gesture, combined with him pinching her nose earlier, made Maria lower her head shyly while stealing glances at him. Her heart raced, and she felt incredibly embarrassed.
"David confirmed that you are indeed an employee here.

"But there are strict employment rules here. According to the regulations, every employee must have a labor contract. Even handing out flyers needs to be done through a qualified outsourcing company."

"That bastard Connor pulled a dirty, disgusting move. If this got exposed, it would be really bad for the brand. So David is chewing him out now and stating clearly that their company never had any budget for temporary workers or summer jobs."
"David told this bastard to fix it himself. If he doesn’t handle it properly, he can pack up and get lost."
Maria listened in a daze, then bit her lower lip and said with admiration, "Big brother, your Spanish is amazing! Are you a translator?"
"Me? I’m just unemployed!"

Luis laughed self-deprecatingly, patted her shoulder, and motioned with his chin. "He’s coming over to apologize. Don’t hold back—vent your anger. If I hadn’t been here today, he would’ve taken advantage of you for free."
The way he said it... Maria’s face flushed, but her earlier grievances turned into anger, and she gritted her teeth.

Manager Connor walked over with a sour expression, looking very reluctant. He gritted his teeth and said, "Maria, your wages are 1,723 dollars. I’ll give you 1,750, and let’s call it even. Here, take it."
As he spoke, he picked up his phone to transfer the money. Luis sneered and said, "You’re making it sound so light. An extra 27 dollars? Are you treating her like a beggar?"
Manager Connor said in a low voice, "Sir, we have no grudge between us. There’s no need for you to be so aggressive."
"I called David all the way here, and you think it’s only worth 27 dollars?"
Luis coldly laughed. "Listen, kid, I wouldn’t care if someone made money by risking their life, but making money by being unethical—that’s something I can’t stand."
"If I weren’t here, would you have just stolen this little sister’s entire summer job wages? Now you talk like it’s nothing, not even offering an apology, and expect it to be over??"
"Your face isn’t that big."
Mentioning David again made Manager Connor’s stiff expression wilt. He gritted his teeth, bowed to Maria, and said, "I’m sorry. This was indeed my fault. I was greedy and tried to cut corners."
"As compensation, I’ll transfer 4,000 dollars to you. Consider the extra as a token of my apology. Please be magnanimous and don’t hold it against someone like me."
The attitude was decent enough. Luis thought this guy was something—able to bend and stretch—so there was no need to push him too hard.
But then Maria, who had always seemed gentle and obedient, suddenly turned fierce. She swung her hand and slapped him across the face.
The slap was crisp but not particularly hard. Manager Connor’s glasses flew off, and his face tilted slightly to the side. He covered his cheek in disbelief, visibly angry as he straightened up.
Luis immediately stepped in front of Maria, surprised that this seemingly meek girl had such a fierce side—not just the pitiful image she projected.
"Maria, you’re going too far."
Manager Connor’s eyes were turning red.
Being slapped in front of everyone, with his employees watching, was utterly humiliating.
Even Luis frowned, feeling it was a bit excessive. Just as he was about to say something, Maria hid behind him, cautiously poking her head out, and spat:
"How is it too far? Was it not too far when you slapped my ass? I’m not even close to you.
"Don’t think I don’t know, you tried to take advantage of me and got rejected. That’s why you deliberately withheld my pay."

Manager Connor’s face turned even uglier. Hearing this, Luis no longer thought it was excessive. Sexual harassment in the workplace, targeted at a summer intern who wasn’t even earning much—this guy was downright scum.
"Then we’re even now, right?"
Manager Connor covered his face, speaking in a gloomy, low tone without pressing further, his eyes nervously darting again and again toward David.
"We’re even!"
Maria didn’t want to push it further either.
"Go change out of your uniform, then leave!"
Manager Connor breathed a sigh of relief. As long as she didn’t pursue it, David would act like nothing happened. The cost of over two thousand dollars and a slap wasn’t actually high.
One could only say that student girls were easy to satisfy. If it were a woman who had seen more of the world, she would have extorted him until he was financially crippled.
"Big brother, don’t leave yet. Wait for me!"
Maria was quite familiar with him already, probably afraid that Connor would try something shady. As she ran into the changing room, she pitifully added, completely treating Luis as her lifeline.
Only then did David walk over. Manager Connor quickly explained that the matter had been resolved and promised he would be more careful in the future.
"Luis, I’m leaving in a couple of days. Are you sure you won’t have a drink with me?"
David said irritably, "I’m sick of that idiot translator they found for me. I rarely get to travel for work and wanted to experience local cuisine and different customs."
"That moron took us out for steak yesterday, saying he was afraid we wouldn’t be used to local food. Then at the bar, he ordered a tasteless thing. FUCK..."
Luis couldn’t help laughing. "Alright, but let me finish shopping first."
"Manager Connor, three iPhone 14s, and two of the highest-configuration iPads!"
Manager Connor was momentarily stunned, then quickly agreed and went to get the items. Maria changed back into her own clothes and walked out—well-fitted jeans and a blue top.

With her hair tied in a ponytail, she looked refreshingly elegant. She was quite pretty with good proportions—no wonder Connor had harassed her. At first glance, she wasn’t stunning, but the more you looked, the more attractive she seemed.
Luis had already swiped his card and collected the gift bags. He turned to David and said, "I have something to take care of first. I’ll see you at dinner."
"Okay, I’ll wait for your call!"
David made a phone gesture with his hand.
Just after getting off the elevator, Maria looked at Luis with a smiling face and asked, "Big Brother, what’s your name? What’s your phone number? Let me add you on Whatsapp right now."
"Sure!"
After exchanging contact information, they reached the mall entrance. Maria bit her lower lip and asked, "Luis, thank you for today. But why was David willing to help me??"

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Lily Is Worried
paragraphs: "Him? He’s here on a business trip with his family. If I filed a complaint, he’d be done for."
Luis spoke in a doting tone and patted her head. Maria blushed but didn’t refuse the intimate gesture. In fact, the feeling of being protected and cherished today was especially wonderful.

"Remember this from now on, little one—there are still plenty of bad people in society. Someone like David being righteous today isn’t because he’s a good person; it’s because that bastard has a weakness I can exploit."
"Got it, thank you, Luis."
Maria blinked her big eyes and said, "Brother, let me treat you to dinner tonight, okay?"
"Another day. I already promised to treat that bastard David to dinner tonight."
"Then let me go with you. I can’t let you spend money because of my issue."
"Alright, see you in a bit!"
She’s quite thoughtful, Luis thought to himself before agreeing. After saying goodbye to her, he headed straight home.
The three sisters at home were still busy. As soon as Leah saw her brother-in-law, her face turned red, and she dodged away like a little thief—it was actually pretty adorable.

All the furniture for the master bedroom had arrived. The new wardrobe and new king-sized double bed, two computer desks, and a vanity were arranged spaciously without any crowding. It really made him realize just how cluttered things used to be.
"So, are you satisfied?"
Nancy stood at the doorway, speaking with a proud tone.
"This must be big sister’s work. Big sister always has great taste."
Seeing his fair-skinned, beautiful sister-in-law with her stunning legs, Luis immediately complimented her.

It had to be said, her return to the family home was perfectly timed. His delicate wife Lily had perfectly inherited her mother’s stingy tendencies. If she were put in charge of buying things, she’d definitely pick the cheapest options with the best cost-performance ratio—maybe even dig through secondhand markets.
But Nancy was different—she spent money extravagantly, was vain and materialistic, and had no self-restraint when it came to spending her own money, let alone someone else’s.
All the new furniture was high-end. Not only was Luis particularly satisfied, even Leah couldn’t stop smiling.
"What kind of bed costs 1,500 dollars? What’s so good about it?"
In stark contrast was Lily, who was hanging laundry. She had taken the opportunity to wash all the clothes, waiting to organize everything tomorrow.
Luis seized the chance to switch to his new phone. As soon as he inserted the SIM card, a System notification sounded in his mind:
"Ding... Data loading, APP downloading, data transferring..."
Nancy noticed the shopping bag on the table, her eyes darting around as she asked, "Brother-in-law, why did you buy so many phones and tablets?"
"For business use!"
Luis replied casually. Seeing the glint in Nancy’s eyes, he had a vague idea of what she was thinking.

His sister-in-law was still using a 12. When she bought it back then, she had bragged about it for a long time. With her personality, she was well-acquainted with expensive things—there was no way she wouldn’t recognize that this was the latest and most expensive model.
If nothing else, when it came to squandering money, Nancy had absolute authority in the family.
"The latest iPad—this must’ve cost over 1,000 dollars, right?
Nancy opened the bag herself and looked inside, her eyes instantly lighting up.
"Brother-in-law, that’s not right. You’re using a 14, but my sister uses an Android. Look, I’m still using a 12."
"Also, I kept it a secret for you before—you bought little sister a 14 too. Mom and Lily might not understand, but you can’t fool me."
"Giggle, you better thank me properly. If Mom and Lily found out, your ears would be burning for sure!"

Luis maintained a lukewarm attitude toward her. Even though he noticed she was hinting at something, he pretended not to understand. Since the mission line hadn’t been activated yet, Luis didn’t want to waste energy for now.
"Thanks for covering for me, big sister. I’ll treat you to a meal another day."
Luis took a shower, changed into clean new clothes, tidied his hair, and looked at his handsome face in the mirror—he couldn’t help but feel a little narcissistic.
"Wife, I have to go out for dinner tonight. You guys handle dinner on your own."
"Okay."
As soon as Luis left, Nancy leaned in with a mysterious expression and said, "Lily, how can you be like this?"
Lily, while hanging clothes, asked puzzledly, "What did I do?"
Nancy didn’t hold back and said bluntly, "Where is he going? Who is he eating with? Is it with a woman? You should at least ask."
"Why should I ask? Luis has his own career to focus on. The least I can do is not hold him back."
Lily continued working as she spoke.
Nancy stomped her foot in frustration. "You’re such a fool. Aren’t you afraid some vixen will steal your husband? Or that he’ll fool around outside?"
Lily shook her head and smiled. "Big sister, I trust him on this. Luis isn’t the type to play around."
"Don’t be so naive. That was before."
Nancy spoke with a tone of exasperation. "Now that he’s changed his clothes, my brother-in-law is quite handsome. Plus, he has some money now."
"He might not be a player, but the vixens out there will throw themselves at him."
"Th-then what should I do!"

"Brother-in-law... don’t..."
"We’ll be discovered...

The sister-in-law struggled with shame and weakness, yet still half-heartedly gave in, savoring the passionate entanglement of their tongues and teeth. For her, this was already an irresistible pleasure.

Plus, that sneaky hand of her brother-in-law grew increasingly bold, groping and kneading her firm, springy buttocks through her pants. With each squeeze, she felt a numbing, electric sensation that made her lose control and want to sink deeper into it.
"Sweetheart, be good. Next time, brother-in-law will go even further."
"Drop dead, you pervert brother-in-law."

Her sky-blue dress outlined the young girl’s delicate and graceful figure. A green hair clip held her ponytail in place, giving her a fresh and lively look. "Very pretty. Have a seat."

"’I don’t care if you earn money at the risk of your life, but if you earn dirty money, I’ll make it my business to interfere...’"

Maria repeated the words Luis had said earlier, her eyes full of admiration. Then she giggled and said, "And also, when I was crying, you comforted me. After I hit that piece of shit Connor, you immediately stepped in front to protect me."
"After I went back, I kept thinking about all those little details. They were just full of a sense of security. At that moment, I really wasn’t scared at all."
Maria stuck out her tongue playfully and said with a laugh, "It was actually my first time hitting a man. I was really nervous at the time too."
"Oh? From the way you said that, it sounds like you’ve hit women before."
"Hah, I’m not telling you!"

If I filed a complaint, he’d be done for."
Luis spoke in a doting tone and patted her head.
Maria blushed but didn’t refuse the intimate gesture.
In fact, the feeling of being protected and cherished today was especially wonderful.
"Remember this from now on, little one—there are still plenty of bad people in society.
Someone like David being righteous today isn’t because he’s a good person; it’s because that bastard has a weakness I can exploit."
"Got it, thank you, Luis."
Maria blinked her big eyes and said, "Brother, let me treat you to dinner tonight, okay?"
"Another day.
I already promised to treat that bastard David to dinner tonight."
"Then let me go with you.
I can’t let you spend money because of my issue."
"Alright, see you in a bit!"
She’s quite thoughtful, Luis thought to himself before agreeing.
After saying goodbye to her, he headed straight home.
The three sisters at home were still busy.
As soon as Leah saw her brother-in-law, her face turned red, and she dodged away like a little thief—it was actually pretty adorable.
All the furniture for the master bedroom had arrived.
The new wardrobe and new king-sized double bed, two computer desks, and a vanity were arranged spaciously without any crowding.
It really made him realize just how cluttered things used to be.
"So, are you satisfied?"
Nancy stood at the doorway, speaking with a proud tone.
"This must be big sister’s work.
Big sister always has great taste."
Seeing his fair-skinned, beautiful sister-in-law with her stunning legs, Luis immediately complimented her.
It had to be said, her return to the family home was perfectly timed.
His delicate wife Lily had perfectly inherited her mother’s stingy tendencies.
If she were put in charge of buying things, she’d definitely pick the cheapest options with the best cost-performance ratio—maybe even dig through secondhand markets.
But Nancy was different—she spent money extravagantly, was vain and materialistic, and had no self-restraint when it came to spending her own money, let alone someone else’s.
All the new furniture was high-end.
Not only was Luis particularly satisfied, even Leah couldn’t stop smiling.
"What kind of bed costs 1,500 dollars?
What’s so good about it?"
In stark contrast was Lily, who was hanging laundry.
She had taken the opportunity to wash all the clothes, waiting to organize everything tomorrow.
Luis seized the chance to switch to his new phone.
As soon as he inserted the SIM card, a System notification sounded in his mind:
"Ding...
Data loading, APP downloading, data transferring..."
Nancy noticed the shopping bag on the table, her eyes darting around as she asked, "Brother-in-law, why did you buy so many phones and tablets?"
"For business use!"
Luis replied casually.
Seeing the glint in Nancy’s eyes, he had a vague idea of what she was thinking.
His sister-in-law was still using a 12.
When she bought it back then, she had bragged about it for a long time.
With her personality, she was well-acquainted with expensive things—there was no way she wouldn’t recognize that this was the latest and most expensive model.
If nothing else, when it came to squandering money, Nancy had absolute authority in the family.
"The latest iPad—this must’ve cost over 1,000 dollars, right?

"Brother-in-law, that’s not right.
You’re using a 14, but my sister uses an Android.
Look, I’m still using a 12."
"Also, I kept it a secret for you before—you bought little sister a 14 too.

"Giggle, you better thank me properly.

Luis maintained a lukewarm attitude toward her.
Even though he noticed she was hinting at something, he pretended not to understand.
Since the mission line hadn’t been activated yet, Luis didn’t want to waste energy for now.
"Thanks for covering for me, big sister.

Luis took a shower, changed into clean new clothes, tidied his hair, and looked at his handsome face in the mirror—he couldn’t help but feel a little narcissistic.

"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Maria Within Reach
paragraphs: "I wouldn’t have guessed!"
Luis was a bit surprised.
"Want me to do the splits for you?!"
Maria said proudly, "Don’t judge me by how slim I am—I have abs, you know."

Luis laughed. "I’d actually love to see that. Both the splits and the abs. But I really wouldn’t have guessed you’re an athlete. I always thought athletes, regardless of gender, were all bulky with muscle."
"It depends on the sport. Some require gaining fat and muscle, others require losing fat and gaining muscle. Different events have different training methods."
"Some athletes get tanned as dark as charcoal, but we’re in the water all the time. Our skin gets soaked until it’s pale, almost like corpses."

Chattering away, Maria was very happy. She stuck out her tongue cutely and said, "Am I being a bit annoying? Back when I was training in the sports team, it was all girls, and the coach was really strict."
"When I got to university, I thought I’d have more freedom, but the training intensity actually increased. You have no idea how boring and gossipy a bunch of girls can be when they’re together."
"I’m not really interested in that stuff, but I am quite interested in your abs."
"Pervert!"
Seeing Maria’s coy expression, Luis knew this young girl was still within reach.

During their conversation, her phone rang a few times. Each time, Maria’s expression changed, and she immediately declined the call. Luis noticed that the number displayed didn’t even have a saved name. He joked, "Boyfriend? Did you have a fight? Why aren’t you answering?"
"What makes you think it’s a boyfriend?"
Maria widened her eyes in curiosity, as if she found it hard to believe.
"There’s no contact name, just a string of numbers. That’s suspicious!"
"Unless it’s delivery or takeout, even scam calls deserve to be answered. Hanging up that decisively means you recognize this number."
"We’re in the middle of breaking up."
Maria said irritably, "He’s a high school classmate. That bastard thought he could fool around with other girls while I was studying in the University, treating me like an idiot."
"Now he suddenly wants to reconcile? Reconcile my ass..."
Maria even cursed, angrily saying, "Long-distance relationships are just unreliable. And now he wants to explain? What’s the point? I’ve even seen their bed photos. He just sees me as a backup."
Regarding the lives of young people today, Luis neither approved nor criticized. After all, youth is a time of impulsiveness and high spirits, and all sorts of dramatic things can happen.
"Brother Luis, you’re so attentive."
Maria suddenly looked up, grinning playfully as she said something meaningful.
"Just normal observation, wouldn’t call it attentive."

Luis stretched lazily and smiled. "You’ll be returning to the Study in a couple of days. There must be plenty of handsome guys chasing after you. And with all the muscular men in your sports academy, it’s like heaven—exactly what many women dream of.
"Come on, most of us are in separate divisions. The majority are in women’s events, hardly any men."

Maria rolled her eyes and said bluntly, "I don’t know if it’s because athletes are mostly like beasts, but the relationships here are messy, and a lot of drama happens. Our campus is basically a girls’ school."

"As for sports students, forget it. The ones I’ve met have terrible tempers. Several of my classmates dated sports students from the same school—some got abused, beaten, and I heard there’s even been sexual violence."
Maria suddenly looked at Luis with a smile and said, "If I were to get a boyfriend, I’d definitely want someone gentle and considerate like you, brother."
"Not necessarily. Before they catch you, they’ll pamper you endlessly, but once they get you into bed, their true colors show."

Luis felt a stir in his heart from her gaze. Honestly, before getting system, he had been poor and only somewhat good-looking, with a thin build. Only Lily had been brave enough to love him back then.
Aside from his wife, Luis had never been with another woman before obtaining the System. Facing such sudden flirtation, he really wasn’t used to it.
"I admire you even more now, Brother Luis. You dare to speak such blunt truths."
Maria smiled even more charmingly and said, "Brother, you’re so gentle with me, yet so domineering when dealing with that bastard Connor. You really have two faces, and I like it more and more."
This was already a blatant seduction. Luis could feel his blood heating up.
But just as he was about to say something, the door suddenly opened, and David walked in, greeting them with immense enthusiasm, followed by his family.
Luis stood up, hugged them, and began chatting warmly. Maria sat to the side, immediately behaving obediently, without any trace of her earlier fox-like, seductive demeanor.
Though she couldn’t understand Spanish, watching Luis chat and laugh effortlessly with David, his family, and even the ten-year-old children, Maria’s eyes sparkled with admiration.
Sports academies generally have lower academic standards, but once athletes reach a certain level, they often regret their lack of education.

International competitions require strong foreign language skills. As professional athletes, they become acutely aware of the advantages and disadvantages involved. Not understanding international rules can be a significant disadvantage.
Sports academies do have Language teachers who teach specialized knowledge, but their proficiency is only so-so.

Maria once witnessed a supposedly highly proficient teacher sweating profusely when asked for directions by a foreigner at the school gate. It goes to show how daunting language barriers can truly be.
But after acquiring this skill, Luis’s Spanish was on par with a native speaker’s. He could even adjust to regional dialects and use words that hadn’t even been updated in dictionaries yet.
It was incredible... only simultaneous interpreters had this level of skill, right?
Maria watched, mesmerized. Though she didn’t understand a word, the delighted and approving expressions on David’s family’s faces told her just how skilled Luis was.
Luis held the menu, translating each item for David’s family. David laughed heartily, and the whole family was in high spirits.
After chatting for a while, Luis called the server over to order: "grilled lamb chops, ten grilled bratwursts, ten beef sausages... ten stuffed mushrooms, and ten fried calamari, too..."

He didn’t order any basic items like grilled chicken wings. These dishes were somewhat standard in European-style barbecue, but what followed were items like bacon-wrapped dates and grilled deviled eggs. The only relatively normal thing was grilled oysters.
Beer was served alongside the order—unbranded, locally brewed draft beer from a nearby brewery.
David’s family cheered again. After toasting with them, Maria couldn’t help but ask, "Brother, why didn’t you order any meat skewers or something normal?"
Luis shook his head and said, "This family isn’t normal. Actually, customs vary from place to place. There are things like surströmming and fermented seabirds abroad that we can’t comprehend."
"David’s family did their research before coming. They thought organ meats were the limit.

"But then they tried many bizarre dishes and other things ranked highly on foreign websites, and it drove them crazy. I’ve already asked the restaurant to buy some pickled herring from a Scandinavian deli down the street to satisfy them."
"There’s no blood pudding or tripe stew around here, but they want to try local weird delicacies. These guys..."

"How should I put it? They call themselves brave food adventurers—they don’t want ordinary food. The owner of this place is from Eastern Europe and has things like pig’s ear terrine and jellied pork, which happen to satisfy them."
Luis smiled and said, "Since you’re treating, this won’t even cost much."
"Brother, you’re really thoughtful. I was worried at home for so long, afraid you’d pick a place that was too expensive."

Maria said coyly, "I looked it up when I got back—David is actually a high-level HR executive for the flagship store in the Asia-Pacific region. I never expected him to come to a small street stall like this."
As they spoke, cheers and applause erupted from the private room.
It turned out the fried calamari skewers had arrived. David’s daughter was the first to stand up and eat one, and everyone applauded her.
Luis and Maria exchanged a knowing smile and joined in the applause. David’s daughter wasn’t exactly pretty, but she wasn’t ugly either. At that moment, wiping her mouth, she smiled with clear pride.
David suddenly raised his glass and came over, chattering away.
Maria didn’t understand but felt a bit flustered under David’s amused gaze, faintly sensing that his words were related to her.
Luis stood up and clinked glasses with David, who burst into laughter. His daughter seemed to say something else, sounding displeased.
"Brother, what are they saying?"
Maria, already slightly tipsy, tugged at Luis curiously.
Luis had downed three glasses in a row, clearly apologizing for something. The tall foreign girl across from them drank with him but seemed to be joking—probably not actually angry.
Even without understanding the language, their expressions hinted at the general idea, which was quite amusing.

Luis’s face was already flushed from alcohol. He smiled and said, "David’s daughter said she’s very interested in me. She’d be thrilled if I could accompany her on her graduation trip. She’d change her visa immediately and travel with me for a month or two, with David covering all the expenses."
"So direct, huh?"
"Foreigners aren’t as reserved or hesitant. They’re mostly like this."
"Then what did the bald guy say to you??"

Maria asked this question, and Luis smiled, using his finger to playfully lift her chin. "The first thing he said was that his daughter mentioned if you don’t mind, the three of us could travel together. Of course, she hopes I can keep up."
"Aside from thinking I’m great, she also thinks you’re great. She believes you must have a fantastic figure."
"Psychos!"
Maria’s face turned bright red upon hearing this. She simply couldn’t comprehend these guys attitudes toward sex.

Luis chuckled. "It’s simple. If you perform well, they keep squeezing you. If you don’t, you’re doomed. If you come from a well off family willing to pay, they’ll sue you for one or two hundred thousand dollars."
"Those with pretty faces and good figures end up selling their bodies to pay the debt."
"A friend of mine worked there. He said before they’re sent out, they have to ’entertain’ the boss and executives for free."
"Then Nova Media introduces them to wealthy sponsors—that’s how those vain school belles and class belles usually end up."
Luis added casually, "If you breach the contract, you pay. If you can’t pay, you pay with your body. You think these agencies make their money from ads?"

Her long legs alone were enough to make people drool, not to mention her figure, which was even more devilish than a model’s, along with her exquisite and captivating face.
Nancy flattered, "Boss Anglo, business here is really lively!"
"These are just small scenes!"
As he spoke, Anglo Nova took her to the top-floor live-streaming room.
Another beauty was there selling products, surrounded by assistants and numerous staff, with a circle of professional equipment.
Describing it as the moon surrounded by stars was no exaggeration.
"Welcome, Big Brother, to the live stream!"
"Big Brother, you’re joking.
We naturally want to recommend more products of good conscience and quality."
"Thank you for the Cosmic Heart, Big Brother.
Thanks for your support..."
The one acting coquettishly was a local internet celebrity with nearly a million followers.
At that moment, she was extremely excited, looking at a board the audience couldn’t see.
According to the records on the board, she had already received over 10,000 dollars in gifts, and sales had broken 100,000.
It might not seem dazzling, but for a small local company, it was a significant number.
Anglo Nova frowned and instructed the staff to push harder, as the numbers were still too low.
Everyone was busy and bustling, yet everything proceeded in an orderly manner.
"Nancy, right?
Your external conditions are quite good.
If you join our company, I can consider focusing on training you."
Anglo Nova could not conceal his lewd, lustful smile.
His hand had already touched Nancy’s palm.
Nancy was hesitating about whether to pull away.
Suddenly, another employee came over and said, "Boss, HR says there are too many applicants, and they’re overwhelmed.
They want you to come help screen them."
"Really?
Ah, fine.
Nancy, come down with me."
When they arrived at a meeting room downstairs, more than twenty young and beautiful girls were already there making inquiries.
The scene could be described as a mixed bag.
There were not only faces that had clearly undergone plastic surgery but also some who looked underage.
Without exception, however, they were all dressed to the nines.
Some who weren’t very attractive were still emphasizing that they used beauty filters and were very photogenic, absolutely 99-point beauties.
In short, it was as chaotic as a food market, with no difference whatsoever.
"The economy is bad now.
Everyone wants to become an internet celebrity and make quick money."
This time, Anglo Nova didn’t make any lewd moves.
Instead, he smiled with a hint of pride and said, "Nancy, your qualifications are very good.
If you join our company, I’ll heavily promote you.
I guarantee you’ll become at least a million-follower-level internet celebrity."
Hearing this, hesitation began to show in Nancy’s eyes, especially after seeing that female internet celebrity selling goods earlier, which made her even more conflicted.
That female internet celebrity’s face was completely not on the same level as hers.
Nancy had also seen her online—one could only say the power of beauty filters was extremely strong.
Seeing her in person, her makeup was like a ghost’s, just barely working with the lighting.
As for her figure... it was a complete washboard—just skinny and tall.
Nancy even thought one of her own breasts was enough for three of hers.
How could she earn so much...
"Um, Boss Anglo, could I take a look at the contract and consider it?"
Nancy asked, remaining relatively calm.
" Forget it, don’t even think about it.
In this era where traffic is king, no one has time for you to be coy."
Suddenly, a few more girls entered—truly young and beautiful, and their style of dress was particularly elegant and charming.
Anglo Nova pointed at them and said, "See?
Even the so-called high school prom queens are here.
We even think university prom queens are too old."
"Don’t you know your own age?
Being married is a real drawback.
Honestly, if your conditions weren’t truly this good, I wouldn’t bother with you.
If you’re not willing, just say so outright.
Why are you more hesitant than a young girl?"
After sending Lily off, Luis felt somewhat dazed.
The omniscient Lust System was extremely powerful—Luis had witnessed everything that occurred, including her signing process, and had also obtained all the information about the company in his mind.
Nancy returned home in a distracted state, filled with anticipation and longing, yet also somewhat anxious and unsure how to bring it up.
She had been informed that in two days, professionals would come to examine her body, and she would need to be completely naked.
The process included measuring various body data—it didn’t seem like a physical examination at all.
It was completely irregular, almost as if they were evaluating her figure.
"Big sister is back!"
Leah had gone to school, Lily had gone to work, and Ruth had also left to play cards.
Strangely, Luis and Nancy ended up alone together.
Although he knew what was happening, Luis immediately decided to play dumb.
He prepared a serving of pork rib and seafood porridge along with some pickled side dishes, then said in a relaxed tone, "Let’s eat together.
The blue crabs are especially good today."
"Sure, it smells wonderful!"
At that moment, Nancy didn’t overthink it.
Believing she had landed a good job, she sat down and began eating the porridge cheerfully.
"I really misjudged you before—this porridge is much better than anything Mom makes."
After exchanging a few lighthearted remarks, Luis suddenly asked, "Sister, last time I went to Ocean World for dinner, what were you doing at the office building next door?"
"Ah... it was nothing, really.
I was just... visiting a friend."
Nancy was momentarily caught off guard.
Her first instinct was to keep it secret.
She thought that if she became a million or even ten million follower internet celebrity later, she could reveal it proudly.
"That’s good—as long as it wasn’t that Nova Media!"
Luis continued eating his porridge calmly, appearing relieved as though nothing were wrong.
But Nancy’s heart was in turmoil.
Anxious and uneasy, she looked at the composed Luis in front of her and couldn’t help asking, "What’s wrong with Nova Media??"
"Why are you asking about that?
It has nothing to do with you."
Luis remained perfectly calm.
Nancy clenched her teeth and said, "I have a friend who works there.
I just wanted to ask."
Luis immediately frowned.
"As an employee or as a streamer?
The question made Nancy nervous.
"An employee—working in lighting."
"That’s fine then, not a big issue.
If it were as a streamer, I’d be mourning for your friend."
Luis spoke in a relieved tone and continued eating.

I heard you can make a lot of money."
"Please.
Their streamers are... hard to describe..."
Luis smirked, then deliberately piqued her curiosity again: "Anyway, since your friend is a regular employee who signed a standard labor contract, you don’t need to worry too much, sis."
Nancy grew more anxious upon hearing this.
"Another classmate of mine is a streamer, though."
"Then let’s observe a moment of silence for her!"
"What do you mean?!"
Nancy’s mind was completely in chaos.
On second thought, she realized she had signed the contract in more than a dozen places without reading it carefully.
"Well, let’s just say big companies can be shady, but small ones are even worse.
Here in our city, Nova Media is basically a legalized mafia."

Hearing this, Nancy’s scalp tingled.
She had signed the contract that very day and received 800 dollars, all of which went toward paying off her credit card.
"Then the contract is extremely detailed—so much so that you could call it predatory.
Simply put, the performance metrics required of the streamer are something only top tier, tens of million follower creators could achieve."
"A newbie could never reach that.
And we’re in a small city with limited resources—it’s impossible to cultivate that level of influence here."
"All that ’school belle’ or ’class belle’ talk is nonsense.

And even if such a team existed, they couldn’t afford it."

If you perform well, they keep squeezing you.
If you don’t, you’re doomed.
If you come from a well off family willing to pay, they’ll sue you for one or two hundred thousand dollars."
"Those with pretty faces and good figures end up selling their bodies to pay the debt."
"A friend of mine worked there.
He said before they’re sent out, they have to ’entertain’ the boss and executives for free."
"Then Nova Media introduces them to wealthy sponsors—that’s how those vain school belles and class belles usually end up."
Luis added casually, "If you breach the contract, you pay.
If you can’t pay, you pay with your body.
You think these agencies make their money from ads?"

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Looking For A Job, Not To Be A Prostitute
paragraphs: "Wh... where then?"
Nancy already felt her vision darkening.
Luis showed her a webpage on his iPad. "Just this year, Nova Media has filed at least fifty lawsuits."

"It’s all the same old trick. They come in, paint this grand, lavish picture to get you to sign, then hand over a pitifully small signing bonus. If they sign a hundred people, just one of them gaining traction would cover their costs. The real profit comes from suing the other ninety-nine for breach of contract."

Seeing her on the verge of a complete emotional breakdown, Luis put on an act of ignorance and said with a laugh, "It’s just the same old story, really. You’re not a fool, Big Sister; you definitely wouldn’t be tricked by something like that."
"But, Brother-in-law," Nancy asked, her voice trembling, on the brink of collapse, "if you’re the defendant, the worst that should happen is you pay money. How does it become paying with your body?"
"If you can’t pay the compensation, it’s either forced enforcement or you sign a new contract under their terms for a... different kind of settlement."
Luis said it all very casually. "By that point, they’ll tell you to sleep with whoever they want. What does being an ’internet celebrity’ matter then? It’s just a fancy price tag for a prostitute."
"The moment you sign, those clauses become active."

Nancy felt her breathing grow uneven, coming in short, panicked gasps. "You said yourself they’re predatory clauses," she pressed urgently, "so they must be illegal, right? There has to be a way to fight them."
"There is!"

Luis said cheerfully. "If your family situation is decent and you can scrape together the cash, the two of us could just dig in and fight a drawn-out, messy legal battle. Spending tens of thousands on lawyer fees would make it meaningless for them."

"With lawsuits, if they run into a stubborn defendant who’s willing to drag it out, even with their in-house legal team, they can’t afford the drain on resources. At most, they’d settle for another mediation."
"I’m going to go lie down for a bit!"
He knew exactly what was happening, yet pretending to be clueless was deeply immoral, but it was also incredibly, perversely thrilling.

Luis smiled and said, "Big Sister, don’t overthink it. It’s your friend who got scammed; she’ll find her own way out. Given Nova Media’s reputation, she’ll probably be selling herself soon enough anyway."
"The important thing is that you didn’t get tricked. Just remember to stay far away from all this."
With that, Luis went upstairs first, leaving Nancy standing there, her face pale and unsettled, her mind racing with chaotic, fearful thoughts.
The next day, Nancy arrived at Nova Media early in the morning as agreed. Anglo’s secretary led her to a secluded room.

Anglo and two other executives, a man and a woman, sat across from her. The woman looked over the documents and spoke first. "You’re Nancy, correct? The measurements you provided should be accurate, yes?"
"They are!
Nancy sat there, her heart pounding with anxiety.
Though Anglo and the male executive tried to maintain serious, professional demeanors, the lecherous hunger in their eyes was poorly hidden. They stared at her as if they wanted to devour her whole.
"Alright then, go behind the curtain and remove your clothing. We need to verify your proportions."
The woman said it lightly, as if it were the most normal request in the world.
Nancy’s delicate brows furrowed. "You... want me to what??"
"This is simply part of the procedure."
Anglo also adopted a stern, official tone. "Doctors examine patients’ bodies every day. Which patients get shy about it?"
The other man chimed in impatiently, "Hurry up. Our time is limited. This is all stipulated in the contract, you know."
Hearing that, Nancy hesitated, but finally walked behind the curtain. She took a deep, shaky breath and took off her dress.

She was wearing a set of black lace lingerie today. The style wasn’t overly revealing, but on her, it was exquisitely sexy, perfectly highlighting her devilishly proportioned, breathtaking curves while still tactfully concealing the most intimate areas.
Summoning her courage, Nancy walked out in her underwear. Before the woman could even speak,
Anglo frowned first, tapping his pen on the table. "Why are you still wearing underwear? How are we supposed to know if you’re wearing padding or something?"
The other man glanced at her file, his tone dripping with impatience. "According to your file, you’re married. You’re not some blushing virgin anymore, so why the prudish act?"
"Exactly. If it weren’t for your exceptional potential and raw material, the fact that you’re married would have been enough to disqualify you immediately," Anglo said bluntly, his voice harsh.
"Do you think milf is some trending niche? Have you been watching too much porn? The traffic algorithms favor youth, innocence, and slender figures these days."

They expressed their displeasure without any pretense of courtesy. The female executive joined in, saying, "Stop wasting our time. If you don’t take everything off, how are we supposed to take your measurements properly?"
A hint of menace flickered across Anglo’s face. "Nancy, once you become a streamer, the outfits we provide will be custom-tailored. This initial fitting is a critically important step."
Nancy gritted her teeth. "But you didn’t explain this clearly yesterday."
Anglo looked utterly unconcerned, a picture of arrogant confidence. "What a joke. Do they give you a detailed breakdown of undressing for a physical exam?"

At this point, the female executive adopted a tone of utter exasperation. "Director Anglo, if she’s going to be this uncooperative, I have other matters to attend to. Nobody has time to coddle her with a mountain of work waiting."
Anglo’s eyes glinted with a threatening light. "Nancy, you signed the contract."

Nancy lowered her head and walked back behind the curtain. The three of them exchanged smug, silent smirks, believing they had won. But suddenly, the curtain swished open again—and Nancy hadn’t taken off her underwear. Instead, she had put her dress back on.
"Nancy! What is the meaning of this?!" Anglo’s face instantly darkened.

Nancy walked over, took eight hundred dollars from her bag, and slammed it down on the table, her expression cold and furious. "I came here looking for a job, not to prostitute myself. You offer peanuts, expect me to work, and then demand to see my body? What kind of fools do you take me for?"

Anglo glanced at the money on the table and let out a cold, derisive laugh. "Nancy, are you an idiot? The contract you signed is legally binding, in black and white. You think just returning the money settles this?"
"What else do you plan to do? I haven’t officially started working for you yet!"
Nancy spat the words out with contempt, turned on her heel, and strode out of the conference room.
"What do we do now?!"
"Damn it! She seemed so gullible yesterday. How did she suddenly get so shrewd?"
"Boss, Young Master Dener said he’s tired of little girls and wanted to try a married woman. It’s such a waste to let a premium piece like her get away!"
"Tell that punk Dener to get lost. He barely spends any money and yet makes so many demands. I had plans for that woman; I was going to get my hands on her and sell her for a high price!"
"What a pity. We’ve been running this operation for so long, and I think she’s the most beautiful one we’ve seen. Great body, and those legs... impossibly long. Just looking at them gets me going."
"Absolutely. She’d make one hell of a ride."

Anglo’s eyes were bloodshot, filled with furious resentment. The more he thought about it, the angrier he got. "Goddamn it! The contract is signed! Does she think I’m stupid?! Contact the lawyer, now! Spend whatever it takes, pull strings, get the case filed and before a judge immediately!"
"If she doesn’t pay me a hefty sum, I will make sure her life is a living hell!"

Nancy, her mind reeling and her expression dazed, had just stepped out of the elevator when someone suddenly grabbed her arm. She jumped in fright, thinking Anglo had sent someone after her. A scream was just rising in her throat when a strong, familiar hand clamped over her mouth.
An arm wrapped around her waist, pulling her swiftly into the fire escape stairwell. A familiar voice sounded in her ear, low and urgent, "Big Sister, don’t scream. It’s me."

Feeling the tall, devilish curves of his sister-in-law pressed against him, Luis couldn’t control the immediate, hardening reaction it provoked. But worried about ruining his image, he deliberately maintained a slight distance, not taking any further advantage.
As he spoke, he loosened his grip. Nancy let out a long, shuddering breath, then swatted at his arm. "What are you doing here? You scared me to death!"
"Big Sister, I was worried about you!" Luis explained. "I got my iPad back last night, and it was full of search history about this stuff. I immediately knew something must have happened to you."
"This... Ugh!"
"Let’s talk about it at home."

chapters.title: Chapter 92: How About I Have You Instead!
paragraphs: After returning home, Luis directly pulled her into his mother-in-law’s room. Seeing her brother-in-law’s mysterious demeanor, Nancy, who was already burdened with worries, didn’t overthink it and followed him inside with a sigh.
Luis sat at the head of the bed and spoke first: "Sister, last night I grew more and more uneasy, so this morning I followed you. I apologize."
"It’s fine, you were concerned about me too."
Nancy shook her head, appearing too weary to say much more.
Perhaps she felt too ashamed, or perhaps she believed talking to Luis would be pointless.
As she was lost in thought, Luis handed his phone to her.
The moment Nancy opened the video, her face instantly changed color. The video showed her taking off her skirt behind the curtain, and even the style of her underwear was clearly visible.
"You... where did you get this?"
Nancy was so agitated her eyes widened.
"I told you I know someone who works there. I warned you earlier that this isn’t a legitimate company."
Luis took his phone back and said, "Don’t worry, my friend has already deleted this video. When others check, they’ll only see that the camera was broken."

This was actually the System’s doing. The omniscient skill allowed Luis to understand Nancy’s situation through any network-connected device, no matter where he was. The power of this function was truly immense.
Hearing this, Nancy first felt relieved, then anxiously grabbed Luis’s hand and said, "Brother-in-law, what do you think they’ll do to me?"
"It’s still unclear. Let’s wait for news from my friend tonight."
The System was still gathering various types of information; filtering and identifying what was useful would take time. Honestly, Luis hadn’t realized this cheat-level bug was so formidable.
And it wasn’t a one-time use—it could perform corresponding operations based on his progress in pursuing Nancy. It was like having a god’s perspective.
"Alright, I’ll wait then!"
Nancy returned to Leah’s room somewhat absentmindedly.
Luis also went back to his room to rest. During that time, he faintly heard her phone ring many times without her answering, guessing it was probably calls from the bank.
"Ding... The Tall, Sexy Sister-in-Law questline is now open. Quest 1... Sister-in-Law’s Legjob. Reward: 100,000 dollars cash, two random blind boxes, 1 attribute point."
"Ding... Quest hidden benefit triggered: The Materialistic Sister-in-Law’s Vanity."
"Ding... Sister-in-Law questline: Fuck Sister-in-Law Until She Calls You Daddy, complete the special ’Sugar Daddy’ honor."
"Upon completion, all money spent on Sister-in-Law will be doubled and returned as reward."
Luis abruptly sat up, both shocked and delighted. He hadn’t expected such a windfall.

He was well aware of his sister-in-law’s vanity, but he hadn’t realized it was this extreme. The System seemed to imply that romancing and wooing her would be dull; directly spending money to keep her would be far more thrilling.
Fucking her until she called him daddy would yield double returns, the reward was incredibly generous.

But after calming down, Luis felt a bit dazed. He only had a little over a million dollars to spend; even if he spent it all on her and she eventually called him daddy, the return wouldn’t be substantial.
He needed to complete more quests to build up his funds. Spending all his extra money on her would yield richer returns, but the challenge was finding a legitimate excuse to do so.
"I’m going back for a bit!"
That afternoon, Nancy suddenly went out. Luis didn’t stop her, after all, with his god’s perspective, none of her movements could escape him.
Through careful monitoring, he learned that Nancy’s credit cards were already maxed out, and she couldn’t borrow a cent from online loans.
The 800 dollars she returned to Anglo was borrowed. After much thought, she was afraid her mother would find out, so she planned to repay that debt first.
Daniel had bought Nancy three LV bags in total, which she treated like her life. She intended to sell one to pay back the money.

"How about I have you instead!"
He turned around and gave her a long, passionate kiss, this kind of affection made Lily completely melt.

After kissing, Lily went back to her room to change into comfortable clothes, then came down to help. When Nancy returned, she seemed distracted. Lily glanced at her and said with a laugh, "Sister, go change first. We’re having seafood hotpot today."
"Oh, okay!"
Nancy seemed to want to say something to Luis, but after a moment’s thought, she stayed silent and went back to Ruth’s room to change.

When Mother-in-Law returned, she was radiant, clearly she’d had great luck. Seeing the spread on the table, she exclaimed, "Son-in-law, you’re really splurging! This table full of seafood must have cost a fortune."
The clear soup base held only a few slices of ginger and peppercorns, along with fish meat from giant grouper, slices of conger eel, blue crab, and tiger prawns.
Luis hadn’t cooked any dishes, he’d just cut a plate of watermelon, arranged the store-bought roast chicken on a plate, and prepared a few bowls of seafood dipping sauce.
"We have to treat ourselves once in a while!"
"Mom, you all start eating first. I’m sweating all over, I’ll go upstairs to change."

He came downstairs shirtless, wearing only a pair of beach shorts. Luis was pleased to see the mother and two daughters already seated and chatting, with drinks and beer set out, yet no one had touched their chopsticks.
This was a clear sign of his elevated status in the household. The moment he sat down, Mother-in-Law Ruth poured beer for him.
Luis casually handed her an iPhone 14: "Mom, this is a new phone. You can change your SIM card after dinner."
"Ah, my old phone still works fine. Why spend so much on a new one for me?"
Ruth’s eyes lit up. Having spent years in teahouses, gossip hubs, even if she wasn’t up-to-date with trends, she knew this was the most expensive and prestigious model on the market.
The gorgeous mother-in-law smiled like an orchid blooming in spring, but as the elder, she still had to offer some polite refusal.
Seeing her mother’s delight, Lily unusually generous, said, "Mom, just take it. Luis bought me a new one too. I was too busy at work today to set it up, we can figure it out together after dinner."
"Oh, and there are two iPads. Mom, you’re not used to using those, my husband said they’re for me and Leah to binge-watch shows at home. He’ll use them if he needs to later."
"Alright!
Ruth agreed immediately.
Typically, Nancy would be the most enthusiastic and interested in such topics.
But now the sister-in-law was clearly distracted, very unlike her usual self.
Lily joked, "Sister, what’s wrong? You’re usually the chattiest one. Don’t tell me Luis made a pass at you when you two were home alone?"

It was purely a joke. Ruth just rolled her eyes and said something inexplicable: "Dream on. I’ve heard of brothers-in-law fooling around with younger sisters-in-law, but when have you ever heard of a brother-in-law messing with an elder sister-in-law?"
Luis choked, nearly spitting out his mouthful of wine, and coughed repeatedly.

Where the hell did this bullshit come from? So being a brother-in-law means you’re destined to lose out, your wife deserves to be lusted after, while being an elder sister’s husband means you’re fated to take advantage??

Nancy wasn’t embarrassed even after being teased. She directly smacked her younger sister’s butt and scolded jokingly, "I’d lend him a hundred times the courage. You’re really asking for it now, daring to crack jokes about me, and of this kind too."
"What, hanging up the ’do not disturb’ sign because your belly’s big, planning to keep all the blessings within the family, huh?"
"That’s fine by me. If big sis doesn’t mind, I don’t mind either. But we have to follow the order of arrival, you’ll have to be the younger one and call me sister from now on."
The two sisters began playfully bickering. Ruth’s face flushed red, and she spat, "Enough, you two. What kind of nonsense are you talking?"
Then she suddenly asked, "Eldest, some bank called me today asking about your overdue credit card bill. What’s going on?"
Hearing this, Nancy froze instantly, her face unable to hide its panic. Ruth’s expression turned serious.
"Mom, that was definitely a scam call."
Luis calmly peeled a large prawn and placed it in his wife’s bowl, saying with a smile, "Telecom fraud is so rampant these days."
"But what the other party said was extremely accurate."
Ruth still seemed doubtful.
"Mom, in this age of big data, scams are highly targeted. The other party even knows you have three daughters, two married, one unmarried."
Luis said cheerfully, "This kind of scam is a bit outdated. Weren’t there ones before where ’police’ accused you of money laundering?"
"True enough!"
Ruth’s expression softened. After all, places like teahouses were full of gossip, and she’d even heard of acquaintances being scammed.
Nancy seized the opportunity to ask, "Mom, don’t tell me you’ve never received a scam call before?"
Lily chuckled and said, "Probably not, right? I’ve gotten a few myself. There was even an absurd one claiming my son was in their hands."
Luis immediately grinned mischievously, winked, and said, "Honey, did you ask the scammer if his hands felt sticky?"
All three women present were married and caught on immediately, bursting into giggles.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Nancy Selling Things
paragraphs: Perhaps it was the alcohol making everyone more relaxed, but the joke didn’t feel inappropriate. In the past, Luis would’ve at least been sternly scolded by his mother-in-law.
Luis also flattered, "Scammers these days target their victims precisely. The fact that they called Mom proves that in their eyes, she’s already a wealthy woman. Let’s toast to Mom!"
"Cheers!"
Sister-in-law Nancy shot him a grateful look. Luis smiled back—words were unnecessary. It wasn’t exactly ambiguous, but the atmosphere had subtly shifted.
Ding... Sister-in-law Nancy: Favorability Meter 50%.
Luis had now figured out the pattern: it was easy to raise low scores, but extremely difficult to increase high ones.

For instance, even though his wife was so satisfied last night, he gave her a new phone and whispered so many sweet nothings, her favorability only rose by 1%, reaching 96%. He had no idea when it would hit 100%.
The most frustrating part was that it could both rise and fall. Luis had to speak and act cautiously, always trying to please, afraid that one wrong word would undo all his progress.
Just then, Lily opened a bottle of red wine. Luis glared and said, "Honey, you’re pregnant—can you drink alcohol??"
Mother-in-law Ruth smiled approvingly and said, "You’re quite sharp."

Lily poured herself a small glass, stuck out her tongue, and said playfully, "Honey, I took the afternoon off. Aunt Yana accompanied me to the Municipal Traditional Medicine Hospital and pulled some strings to have a specialist examine me."
Luis frowned. "What kind of specialist?"
Nowadays, the word "specialist" left a bad taste in most people’s mouths—there were too many unqualified, ignorant frauds out there, as if the title had no standards.
Ruth rolled her eyes and said, "Let Lily finish speaking first. Why the stern face?"
Lily smiled and said, "We can do the machine tests and routine prenatal checkups at our hospital, but I wanted to be extra careful, so I went to the medicine hospital for another examination."

"The specialist Aunt Yana found is no ordinary person. He’s a retired professor from the Big City medical university, rehired by the school. He hasn’t practiced in a long time and now mentors apprentices at the school."

"The old man is 85 years old. He came to our city, this time at the dean’s invitation. The chief physicians at our hospital, several directors at the medicine hospital, and even the dean are all his students."
"That’s amazing!"
Upon hearing this, Luis felt this was likely the real deal.
Ruth said proudly, "What did you expect? I originally wanted to go along, but your Aunt Yana said we shouldn’t disturb the old gentleman."
Lily added, "Aunt Yana didn’t even go in. A director from the medicine hospital led me in—he was almost excessively polite."
"So what did the doctor say?
Luis’s face was full of concern.
Lily took a sip of red wine and said with a smile, "The old man said my constitution is quite good, just a bit different from most pregnant women."

"My body tends to run dry, and my blood circulates slowly. Normally, pregnant women shouldn’t promote blood circulation, but he said I should drink a small amount of white or red wine every two or three days to stimulate blood flow. Also, I don’t need to avoid cold foods like crab like other pregnant women."
"In moderation, once a week is fine—it helps reduce the internal heat in my body."
"And then??"
Luis continued questioning, already taking out paper and a pen to jot down notes with utmost seriousness.

Ruth smiled warmly at the sight and said, "My son-in-law is truly the best. Back when I was pregnant with you girls, your father never asked a single question. I had to serve his whole family even with a huge belly."
Nancy immediately lowered her head, and Lily stuck out her tongue. No one dared to respond for fear of being scolded.

"Then there’s nothing else. Just maintain a normal diet—eat whatever you crave. Pregnant women are usually warned against promoting blood circulation, but he said my blood flows slowly. Once I reach six months and stabilize, I can consider soaking in hot springs."
"No more than ten minutes at a time, twice a month at most. Moderate blood circulation can help the fetus absorb nutrients better."
Luis remembered everything, writing swiftly without missing a single word.
After dinner, Nancy, the sister-in-law who had never done a day of housework in her life, volunteered to wash the dishes and clean the table.
"You all go take a walk, I’ll handle the cleanup here!"
Her phone was on silent during this time, but Luis, sitting nearby, could see numerous calls coming in that she ignored.

After returning from the walk, the mother and her two daughters gathered in the air-conditioned living room. Nancy, the one with the most experience in reckless spending, taught her sister and mother how to use the Apple system, how to switch SIM cards, and so on. In this regard, she was actually quite reliable.
Luis couldn’t wait to return to his room, entered the world of the System, and used the all-knowing cheat to activate God Mode, wanting to see what Nancy had been up to all afternoon.

The scene showed surveillance footage from a pawnshop. The appraiser picked up the LV bag Nancy brought in and shook his head: "The condition isn’t great. I’d be worried about losing money even if I offered 200."
Nancy’s voice was shocked: "200? I spent 2,300 on this when I bought it."

"Other people’s bags are maintained by the boutique, and they rotate between several bags. Yours clearly has been used frequently without any upkeep. The wear is severe—look, this patch of leather is even peeling off."
"Maybe you should try another shop."

Not giving up, Nancy went to another store, but what they told her made her even more disheartened: the bag was too worn to be worth restoring, it was an outdated style not worth much since it wasn’t a limited edition, and they advised against even attempting repairs.
Rejected!
Nancy felt her head spinning. She returned to the first shop, this time bringing all three of her bags.
"Two are heavily worn, this one is passable, but it’s still not a high-end model."
The appraiser was still dismissive.

After all, unless it’s a classic, limited edition, or commemorative piece, luxury goods don’t hold their value well. Many gold-digging women sell their bags almost as soon as the novelty wears off, so the secondhand market is flooded.
In the end, all three bags together—with receipts—sold for just 1,100 dollars. Nancy was heartbroken; she had spent almost 8,000 dollars on them.
It was these very bags that had made her fall head over heels for Daniel, the fake rich second-generation.
Marrying Daniel right after graduating, Nancy was simply unlucky. As a vain, materialistic woman, she somehow never crossed paths with a sugar daddy who could have led her down a path of corruption.
Having seen little of the world, she was easily deceived by Daniel. With her looks and figure, had any wealthy man taken an interest, she would never have sunk to this point.
Luis thought wickedly that he heard Daniel was quite the show-off back then, even driving a sports car—though who knows if it was a flood-damaged clunker.
As soon as Nancy got the money, she transferred 800 dollars to her aunt Eloise. Just like that, her three favorite bags were gone, leaving only 300 dollars in her wallet.
"Brother-in-law, any news from your friend?"
Nancy sent a special message. Luis thought for a moment and replied: "No!"
It seemed she must be panicking now, certainly not as calm as she appeared on the surface. Luis pondered carefully—what he needed was an opportunity to swoop in when she was vulnerable.
He messaged his sister-in-law and Avery, keeping that connection alive.

The sister-in-law was still being flirted with, maintaining an ambiguous atmosphere, while Avery’s messages grew even more explicit, repeatedly asking whether Luis had made a move on the sister-in-law.
"I noticed whenever Bunny and I talk about you, brother-in-law, that silly girl acts a little off. Honestly, have you made a move on your sister-in-law?"
"You’re overthinking it. Maybe it’s just because brother-in-law is handsome."
"So conceited, brother-in-law... I want a iPhone 14 too."
As she spoke, Avery sent a mirror selfie. In the mirror, she wore only a set of pink lingerie, her petite, fair body smooth and tender like soft tofu.

Most striking were those full, enticing breasts—no less impressive than the sister-in-law’s ample bosom—with a cleavage so deep it seemed even more breathtaking, making one eager to see them in their full glory.
"Poor Avery, only able to afford cheap lingerie, brother-in-law..."
"This weekend, does Second Sister have to work? I want to ask Mom if I can sleep over at Bunny’s place."
"I’ll ask later."

"You really dote on your wife."
Nancy’s gaze softened. "What did you ask for? Be honest with me. If you tell me everything clearly, I’ll let you off the hook."
"Sister, please just let me go!"
Luis said pleadingly, "Lily insisted she was going to blow me until I came. I didn’t force her."
Hearing this, Nancy seemed to recall the scene she witnessed last night and the things she heard, but her face still flushed slightly as she pressed further: "And then?"

The more she spoke, the more outrageous this became. But with her face flushed from alcohol, she looked incredibly alluring. That face, so reminiscent of Penny Tai, now carried a seductive, enchanting charm.
It was like a fox spirit not vulgar, but bewitching. Her eyes held a tipsy haze, and a single glance from her was enough to make a man’s thoughts stir.
"Sister, this is our privacy."
Luis retreated strategically: "If something’s bothering you, I’ll drink with you. But why are you asking about private matters between a husband and wife?"
She clinked her can against his and then downed the beer boldly in one go.
Nancy set down her drink, widened her eyes, and said, "Privacy, my ass. You’re saying that to me, your sister? You’re treating me like an outsider, aren’t you?
"You little punk, explain yourself clearly. I was listening from the bedroom and ended up getting all worked up myself."

"Hearing Lily moan for so long, I could tell it was just you pleasuring her. She didn’t even give you head for very long. I’m definitely going to tell Mom about this and have her scold Lily too."

Nancy frowned delicately.

"I am utterly furious. Accompanying her to the prenatal appointments is non-negotiable—that is the first point."
